jobs.title: Client Account Services - Senior Operations Manager - Vice President
jobs.description:
Help shape how a critical client-facing service runs—today and for the future. You’ll lead strategic improvements that raise capacity, quality, and resiliency across complex workflows. We’ll look to you to bring structure to ambiguity, align senior partners, and turn ideas into outcomes. You’ll have visibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to grow your leadership scope. If you enjoy building operating models and delivering change at scale, we’d like to meet you.

As a Senior Operations Manager within Client Account Services team, you will lead strategy, governance, and cross-functional delivery to improve service performance and enable sustainable operating gains. You’ll translate business priorities into a clear roadmap, drive operating model reviews, and ensure execution discipline across milestones, risks, and benefits realization. You’ll partner with senior leaders across technology, product, risk, compliance, finance, and the business to align priorities and unblock decisions. You’ll embed a strong controls mindset while continuously improving processes and ways of working. You’ll also lead and develop managers and teams, reinforcing accountability and inclusive leadership.

Client Account Services supports core account servicing capabilities and operational processes that enable a strong client experience. We work across functions to improve throughput and quality while strengthening governance, controls, and transparency. Our work blends day-to-day operational excellence with multi-year modernization through process and technology change.

Job responsibilities:

- Define and evolve the Client Account Services strategy aligned to business priorities and translate it into a measurable multi-year roadmap

- Identify emerging trends and apply automation, artificial intelligence, process mining, and data modernization to deliver measurable operating gains

- Lead end-to-end operating model reviews and redesign across roles, workflows, governance, and metrics to improve throughput, quality, and resiliency

- Represent Client Account Services in senior steering committees by clearly communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions needed

- Establish and run a disciplined governance cadence, including decision logs, ownership clarity, and follow-through across forums and working groups

- Drive execution rigor across milestones, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, capacity, financials, and benefits realization to ensure outcomes land

- Build trusted partnerships across technology, product, risk, compliance, finance, and business stakeholders to align priorities and deliver change

- Produce executive-ready narratives, updates, and decision memos tailored to senior decision-makers

- Own service performance by defining key performance indicators and service levels, embedding controls, and enabling continuous improvement

- Lead cross-functional delivery (direct and matrixed) to implement process and technology change at scale

- Coach and develop managers and teams by setting clear objectives, reinforcing accountability, and building an inclusive high-performance culture

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

- Bachelor's degree

- At least 10 years of experience in operations, transformation, and/or change management roles within financial services industry

- Prior experience in team management is required

- Experience leading operations, transformation, and/or large-scale program delivery in a complex, regulated environment

- Ability to influence senior executive forums with decision-oriented communication and clear recommendations

- Demonstrated success leading through ambiguity and delivering measurable outcomes

- Experience leading cross-functional stakeholders and driving alignment in matrixed organizations

- Knowledge of operational risk, controls, performance management, and process optimization

- Skill creating executive-ready materials, including updates, narratives, and decision memos

- People leadership experience coaching managers and building accountable, outcomes-focused teams

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

- Experience modernizing operations through digital transformation, including automation, workflow tools, analytics, and artificial intelligence or machine learning

- Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, process mining, and continuous improvement practices

- Experience managing budgets, vendors, and multi-year investment roadmaps

- Advanced structured problem-solving and data-driven management practices

- Strong negotiation and conflict management skills in cross-functional environments


Lead operational transformation and governance to modernize Client Account Services and deliver measurable results.

jobs.title: Cash Management Consultant Senior
jobs.description:
Are you a dynamic professional with a knack for identifying, proposing, and delivering Cash Management solutions? As a Cash Management Consultant Senior, you will have the opportunity to leverage your skills and grow your career, while making a significant impact on our customers and prospects. Join us and be a part of a vibrant team committed to delivering excellence.

As a Cash Management Consultant Senior in Business Banking, you will play a crucial role in the business development process, acting as a trusted advisor to Business Relationship Managers-Acquisition (BRM), Business Development Managers (BDM), their clients, and prospects. You will collaborate with BRMs and BDMs to identify, propose, and deliver suitable Cash Management products and solutions to customers and prospects. In your role, you will strive to provide an exceptional client experience while minimizing risk.

Job Responsibilities:

- Collaborates with Business Relationship Managers-Acquisition (BRMs) and Business Development Managers (BDMs) to drive the development of new profitable Cash Management business while maintaining and growing the existing portfolio. Deliver Results – Individually and as a Team

- Serves as Trusted Advisor through understanding the client’s needs through strategic, consultative conversations; Leverages expertise to make recommendations around payments, receivables, fraud while working within the risk parameters that protect the bank

- Leverage’s knowledge of diverse types of businesses, industries, markets, financial and economic concepts, as well as creative marketing techniques utilizing Chase resources and materials to develop business network and prospects. Protects the firm by following sound risk management protocols and control policies and adhering to regulatory requirements. Escalate issues as identified

- Builds collaborative internal relationships to develop and fosters partnerships with assigned BRMs, BDMs, AMs, MMs and cross functional peers

- Acts as the face of cash management, active in their assigned market; Delivers thought leadership to the market, prospects, clients and COIs on cash flow solutions.  Hosts and presents CPE events for COIs

- Engages in a disciplined relationship development process and manages quality call activities.  Leverage’s prospecting tools such as RelPro and Vertical IQ; Manages proposals for new-to-Chase by utilizing Seismic and Proformas

- Leads new client journey end-to-end; Partners with the client to ensure a successful implementation of Cash Management products; Manages customer expectations by communicating upfront timelines and deliverables. Leverage digital tools to ensure client is versed on self-service options

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

- Minimum 7 years’ experience in Cash Management/Treasury Services or related business experience

- Excellent relationship management and business development/sales skills

- Excellent/strong selling and negotiation skills

- Excellent/strong verbal and written communication skills; Excellent/strong presentation skills

- Maintain strong time management, organizational and planning skills

- Strategic thinking skills

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

- Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or related field

- Certified Treasury Professional certified, or has ability to obtain certification


Join the team providing financial solutions to over 3 million small businesses nationwide at one of the world’s most innovative banks.

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager III
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of payments and merchant services? Join JPMorgan Chase as a Payments Governance Client Operations Manager III and be part of a dynamic team within Third Party Oversight & Governance Operations organization. This is your chance to contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of Third Party Payment Processing Governance. Embrace the opportunity to grow, learn, and lead in an environment that values creativity and collaboration. Your journey to success starts here! As a Payments Governance Client Operations Manager III on the Payments Governance Team, you will play a pivotal role in advancing our mission and driving success.

You will be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, innovation, and excellence, working together to achieve remarkable results. Your contributions will be vital to our firm and the wider community, as we strive to make a positive impact. Join us in a culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and professional growth, where your ideas and expertise are celebrated.

Job responsibilities

- Demonstrate a strong understanding of heightened risk themes and serve as a subject matter expert on the firm’s risk policy decision tree.

- Act as the primary point of contact for reviewing, triaging, and resolving risk escalations for business models requiring enhanced due diligence.

- Maintain comprehensive governance documentation and communicate prohibited or restricted products and services to stakeholders, while serving as a subject matter expert on card network rules and applicable regulatory requirements to assess the design and operating effectiveness of control frameworks.

- Lead and deliver strategic initiatives from intake through execution, including scope definition, milestone management, dependency tracking, risk/issue management, and executive-level status reporting.

- Partner with internal Technology teams and external technical integrators to understand end-to-end payment flows and operational processes, translating governance and control requirements into actionable, implementable outcomes.

- Demonstrate strong client-facing capabilities, including professional presence and effective communication with senior stakeholders.

- Travel to client corporate offices as needed to conduct onsite fieldwork, collect and validate supporting evidence, and deliver insights-driven management reports for due diligence and assessment packages.

- Build strong partnerships across internal stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment to achieve timely outcomes.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of standard operating procedures, governance routines, and change management processes.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Program/project management experience leading cross-functional delivery (preferably in payments, merchant acquiring, processor platforms, or third-party risk/governance contexts).

- Ability to engage credibly with technical teams/integrators and translate technical details into risk, governance, and control requirements (not software development, but technical fluency).

- People management experience with demonstrated coaching and performance leadership.

- Demonstrated executive presence and exceptional presentation capability, with the judgment to make sound, timely decisions under pressure.

- Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and present effectively to senior and executive stakeholders.

- Proven ability to rapidly identify key risk and compliance vulnerabilities and escalate appropriately in accordance with established governance and risk frameworks.

- Strong time management, project management, change management, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to deadlines.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- 3 plus years of people management and leadership experience.

- 5 plus years client-facing or front-office experience.

- Qualifications in a relevant discipline, with a strong track record of detail-oriented execution, professional judgment, and the ability to identify and assess risk issues while operating strategically in a highly regulated environment.

- Experience with Payment Brands (Visa, Mastercard, Discover) program rules and requirements.

- Experience with data analysis (e.g., Microsoft Loop, Microsoft Project, Alteryx, Tableau).


Are you seeking an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the payments and merchant services industry?

jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant - Vice President
jobs.description:
If you want to have a positive impact on underserved small businesses in your market and enjoy building relationships, then a role as a Business Banking Consultant Senior is for you.

As a Consultant Senior in Business Banking, you’ll help improve the lives of our clients and the well-being of their businesses through financial solutions, education, and advice. You’ll be responsible for leading our business development efforts in the Underserved Community segment, specifically focusing on “economic opportunity” areas.

Job Responsibilities

- Build relationships, and utilize networks and local centers of influence to identify and support underserved entrepreneurs

- Creatively look for ways to cultivate long-term relationships with new and existing Community Development Financial Institutions, Non-Profits, and other community organizations, leveraging internal resources such as JPMorgan Chase Foundation

- Maintain current business network and active involvement in community organizations such as Chambers of Commerce and non-profit boards; leverage knowledge of diverse types of businesses, industries, markets, financial and economic concepts; and employ creative marketing techniques utilizing Chase resources and materials to develop business networks and prospects

- Provide the best in client advice and service, and develop the relationship to ensure a seamless client experience throughout Chase. Build collaborative relationships with partners across Chase, including Branches, Home Lending, Chase Wealth Management, and Merchant and Card Services, to provide our clients the best solutions for all of their financial need

- Deliver an outstanding experience to Chase business clients by providing comprehensive and customized business banking solutions tailored to the financial needs and circumstances of their businesses. Use knowledge of business, finance, banking, credit and risk management, while leveraging relationships, to identify, recommend, and promote solutions that best serve the client and ensure the profitability of the portfolio

- Build collaborative internal and external relationships to provide the best in client advice and service to develop the business network, and ensure a seamless experience for the business client

- Discover the personal financial goals and needs of business clients. Partner across lines of business (Chase Wealth Management, Home Lending, Branch Teams) to connect clients with specialists who can help meet their financial needs

Required qualifications,  capabilities, and skills

- Minimum of 5 years’ experience in business banking relationship management role or related business / commercial lending experience

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance or related field, or equivalent work experience

- Strong relationship management skills; demonstrate strong tactical business development and negotiation skills

- Demonstrate seasoned judgment to offer comprehensive and customized solutions that best meet client needs; monitors and researches market/industry trends and business outcomes to anticipate client needs and present proactive solutions

- Able to identify opportunities, issues, and viable alternatives, while managing risk, when traditional solutions do not apply

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Extensive knowledge of business and credit underwriting with commercial credit training

- Experience owning / operating a small business


Join the team providing financial solutions to over 3 million small businesses nationwide at one of the world’s most innovative banks.

jobs.title: Client Ops Manager III
jobs.description:
As an IMOS Service Delivery Vice President in Client Account Services (CAS) , you will be responsible for managing and delivering account reference data readiness for our Investment Middle Office Service clients. CAS IMOS Service Delivery team service our global and regional clients via our global footprint, coordinating end-to-end client account reference data requests, ranging from product expansion to new account launches and onboarding of new Third parties.

The team manages external client relationships as well as partnering with key internal stakeholders within the business, operations, and technology streams to execute client business requirements.

We continuously strive to enhance the client experience of BAU lifecycle management through straight through processing across our robust operating model and ecosystem to ensure accurate and efficient set up to market.

Job responsibilities

- Primary point of contact responsible for the end-to-end client experience and satisfaction for account reference data requests

- Coordination of Client Account lifecycle events with stakeholders, manage successful new account set up -Fund launches, Seg Mandates, New 3 rd Parties and Closures

- Relationship Management - Create long term value through the nurturing of client and key internal stakeholder relationships to deliver a consistently excellent client experience

- Communication – Key liaison between functional teams (Client Services, Operations, Technology, Change Management

- Process Improvement – Partner with internal stakeholders to drive continuous improvement and take an active role in shaping and implementing future target operating model

- Lead client and internal calls to drive implementation deliverables and issue management

- Manage & deliver reporting to client and internally – Toll gates, next actions and status through clear, concise, and audience specific updates

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

- Strong leader combined with demonstrated experience in structuring and managing projects with competing resources, priorities and changing workflows

- Ability to build strong, cohesive partnerships with the Client, business, operations, technology & other key stakeholders and work effectively in a matrix organization

- Experience in leading a regional team with links to global model

- Ability to anticipate, analyze and create data to provide holistic insights and creative, visual story telling

- Logical analysis of complex problems to drive resolutions against daily SLAs

- Detail orientated and able to challenge and improve current operating practices

- Strong Microsoft Office skills and excellent written and oral communication skills

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

- Experience or knowledge in Middle Office functions

- Background of business improvement and optimisation of operating practices

- Proven ability to successfully manage conflict, proven team leadership and meeting facilitation skills

- Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment, and ability to adapt to a changing environment


Come Join as IMOS Service Delivery Vice President in Client Account Services (CAS)

jobs.title: J.P. Morgan Wealth Management - Private Client Investment Associate Team Lead - Columbus, OH
jobs.description:
At J.P. Morgan Chase, we have an enthusiasm for helping our clients, taking care of our employees, building relationships, and delivering extraordinary customer service while maintaining a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. Using a broad investment product and thought leadership platform along with cutting edge digital technology, you will be front and center representing our brand and interacting with our clients to offer the best investment solutions to meet their financial needs.
As a Private Client Investment Advisor Team Lead in J.P. Morgan Wealth Management, you will support the market and serve as a liaison between Advisors and Private Client Investment Associates. You will drive the execution of key strategies and tactics that focus on growth and a world class client experience. You will collaborate with key partners across the J.P. Morgan Wealth Management businesses and One Chase partnerships. This role requires you to be flexible and work in an environment operating at a rapid pace.

Job responsibilities
- Partner with leadership in the coordination, implementation and messaging of key business initiatives to Private Client Investment Associates
- Support Private Client Investment Associate performance and development through onboarding and training, and periodic in field workshops to improve Private Client Investment Associate effectiveness and expertise
- Identify opportunities to develop and deliver best practices to meet and exceed our client expectations and creating a client obsession culture within the team
- Provide field feedback to practice management on key initiatives
- Review and approve time and attendance records for Private Client Investment Associates
- Assist with resolution of various technology issues
- Maintain and update Independent Advisor coverage report
- Serve as liaison and manage relationships between Private Client Investment Associates, Advisors, and Market Directors of Wealth
- Maintain and track revenue share agreements for Private Client Investment Associates
- Strengthen relationships with internal business partners including One Chase partners and branch leadership
- Focus on the employee experience, help define and drive an inclusive culture within the organization

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
- At least 3 years of experience leading teams and coaching in a client-focused environment
- A valid and active Series 7 and Series 66 (63/65) license in addition to meeting the FINRA continuing education requirements
- FINRA Series 9/10 (or equivalent), required or must obtain within 60 days of employment
- Ability to act as an innovative thinker able to drive future engagement with clients to provide an exceptional experience
- Ability to create a climate in which people want to do their best by motivating and empowering others by inviting input from each person and sharing ownership and visibility
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate across J.P. Morgan Wealth Management and with other One Chase partners i.e. Consumer Banking & Business Banking
- Possess strong communication skills, highly professional, attention to detail and excellent follow-through
- High degree of Wealth Management and investment product and technology acumen
- Ability to travel 25% of the time


Reporting to the Client Service Manager, you will manage and serve as a liaison between Advisors and Investment Associates

jobs.title: Private Equity Fund Services – Associate AVP
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Private Fund Services (PFS) team and partner with our Business to provide comprehensive and high quality outsourced administration & banking services to private equity firms and institutional investors. J.P. Morgan enables private equity managers and institutional investors to focus on building wealth - while we take care of all their administrative needs.

Job Summary:

As an Associate in   J.P. Morgan, you will operate in a client centric & end to end model. You will have full ownership of all aspects of fund administration including but not limited to client services, financial reporting, investor relations, and capital event servicing.   Want to work on a private markets fund in its entirety, then this may be the role for you!  A routine day could have an AVP balancing deal funding processes while managing an audit as well as investor queries simultaneously. This brings a great level of dynamism to the role.

Job Responsibilities:

-
Managing monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting, audit, and reporting functions for a portfolio of closed ended and semi closed ended private equity and debt funds.

-
Responsible for LP / investors’ capital calls, distributions, investor financial reports and capital statements.

-
Building strong and meaningful relationships with Client stakeholders through a keen understanding of contractual and service delivery agreements with a dedication to excellent execution against agreed deliveries.

-
Defending against service scope creep and enforcing rigorous Change Control processes.

-
Successful execution of the function’s control frameworks through high quality execution of checklists and procedure production, successful partnerships with Business Control functions as well as Internal audits.

-
Design, build and implement solutions to eliminate manual processes and reduce risk.

-
Responsible for the timely escalation of both successes and issues to Senior Management.

Preferred Qualifications and Requirements

- A proactive attitude demonstrating the ability to multi-task and work to tight reporting deadlines. Organisation and planning skills are key to the role.

- Dedicated to doing the right thing showing ownership and accountability.

- Demonstrates a willingness to own the full end to end servicing of a fund or client relationship.

- Data literate, understanding the importance of the data chain in private market structures and skilled in governing its upkeep. Strong acumen of Alteryx is a distinct advantage.

- An advocate of a global operating model with a drive to develop self and the global team, to improve processes and client outcomes.

- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

- FIS Investran or Arcesium or equivalent double entry accounting platform knowledge a distinct advantage.

- Prior experience in Private Equity fund administration or alternatives funds industry preferred.

- A qualified/part-qualified accountant or with proven experience in accounting with exposure to US/Lux/UK GAAP and IFRS.


Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area?

This role, within the Penetration Testing team, will be responsible for vendor management for third-party penetration testing delivery while owning the delivery excellence agenda across the program—governance, performance, and quality assurance. The role is the primary coordination point between Penetration Testing and the wider strategic functions and governance forums, supporting program-level governance oversight and alignment to Penetration Testing strategy. This is not a hands-on penetration testing role; it is a service delivery, governance, and commercial role with a strong technical and strategy focus. Success in this role requires sufficient technical depth to help shape Pen Test delivery and QA strategy, challenge approaches, and improve consistency of outcomes across vendors and stakeholder groups.

An applicant from a security consulting firm or a financial services background will have a distinct advantage.

Job Responsibilities

The role’s responsibilities include

- Own vendor management for penetration testing delivery, including performance management, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.

-
Establish and maintain program-wide delivery standards (e.g., testing approach expectations, reporting structure, evidence quality, reproducibility, and retest criteria) and ensure vendor adherence.

-
Run vendor governance cadences and maintain KPI-driven reporting, action tracking, and escalation management.

- Own program management oversight of Penetration Testing strategy execution, including maintaining delivery roadmaps and plans (e.g., Gantt/roadmap views), tracking milestones and dependencies, and driving disciplined status reporting.

-
Serve as the primary link between Penetration Testing and wider strategic functions and governance forums to align priorities, reporting, and cross-team initiatives.

-
Coordinate with partner teams (e.g., product/engineering, procurement, finance) to support governance and program execution.

-
Lead a small team by setting direction, allocating work, removing blockers, and building team capability through ongoing coaching and feedback

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

Required skills include:

-
Proven experience in vendor management and program oversight in a large, matrixed organization.

- Demonstrable program management capability (roadmap planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, RAID-style risk/issue tracking) with the ability to produce crisp, executive-ready status reporting.

-
Strong understanding of penetration testing delivery models and the offensive security space (not hands-on execution, but able to challenge, translate, and steer), including the ability to identify gaps in methodology, inconsistent severity, and insufficient evidence/impact articulation.

-
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive decisions and resolve conflicts across technical and non-technical audiences.

-
Experience running governance forums with clear KPI reporting and action follow-through.

-
Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

-
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear executive-ready updates and present effectively to senior stakeholders.

-
Experience in people management, including leading and developing a small team.

Preferred qualifications

Preferred experience includes

-
Experience supporting vendor commercial governance (renewals, rate cards, invoicing) and/or sourcing activities (RFP support).

-
Experience coordinating third-party security testing in regulated environments.

-
Technical background in offensive security, with prior hands-on testing experience, enabling informed oversight while not being a primary execution role.

- Experience running multi-workstream delivery governance (e.g., steering committees, cross-team milestone management, and outcome tracking across vendors/partner teams).

jobs.title: Controls: Governance, Strategy, Change and Insights - Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a first line of defense strategic partner within Asset & Wealth Management (AWM) Control Management, you will help shape the future of risk and control management.   In this role, you will support the Governance, Strategy, Change, and Insights Executive Director (ED) by coordinating governance routines and committee processes that enable the business to proactively manage operational risk, maintain an effective control environment, and drive continuous improvement.

Support AWM Control Management’s Governance, Strategy, Change, and Insights Executive Director by running governance routines and committee processes that help the business proactively manage operational risk and maintain a strong control environment. Coordinate cross-functional inputs and follow-ups, synthesize key risk/control themes and metrics into executive-ready materials, and drive continuous improvement and project delivery across AWM Controls priorities.

Job responsibilities:

- Support governance and escalation protocols by maintaining AWM Business Control Committee (BCC) frameworks and routing potential escalations for review.

- Run the committee operating cadence (agendas, logistics, presenter/SME coordination, and content intake).

- Produce and manage meeting outputs by drafting and reviewing for accuracy and consistency meeting materials, capturing minutes, and tracking action items to closure across stakeholders.

- Coordinate with sub-LOB control committees to collect updates, consolidate inputs, and surface key themes for AWM-level governance.

- Support senior forum deliverables (e.g., leadership business reviews, Audit Committee-related materials) by gathering inputs and ensuring accuracy and consistency.

- Partner across business, operations, legal, compliance, risk, audit, regulators, and technology/control functions to manage inputs and ensure timely follow-through.

- Synthesize risk/control information and metrics (e.g., KRI/KPI-style data, trends, themes) to support messaging, prioritization, and committee decisioning.

- Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to streamline governance processes and reduce manual touchpoints.

- Support business management reporting by tracking headcount movement and expenses versus budget (with Finance) and surfacing variances/opportunities.

- Provide program/project management support for AWM Controls priorities by facilitating cross-Controls discussions, tracking milestones and progress metrics, and helping drive initiatives to completion.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

- 5+ years of experience in controls, audit, quality assurance, operational risk management, governance, compliance, or related fields.

- Strong stakeholder management skills: ability to build relationships across business, operations, technology, audit, compliance, and risk partners; align on competing priorities and drive shared accountability.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills: ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise updates and executive-ready materials.

- Senior Management engagement (lead and support): experience preparing executive-ready materials and coordinating prep meetings (speakers/SMEs, key messages, run-of-show); able to lead select discussions and support senior leaders with content, logistics, follow-ups, and presentations as needed.

- Critical thinking and analytical/problem-solving skills: ability to analyze routine to moderately complex data, identify key issues/patterns, and support fact-based decisions and escalations.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment and shift priorities as needed.

- Proactive and action-oriented mindset with strong follow-through.

- Professional discretion and judgment when handling sensitive topics and materials.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office (especially Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams) and SharePoint.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

- Project management experience: ability to lead deliverables through the full lifecycle (planning, execution, stakeholder coordination, and closure).

- Background in Asset & Wealth Management (AWM) and/or Controls preferred.

- Process optimization / reengineering mindset: challenges legacy ways of working; proposes practical workflow improvements to reduce errors/control gaps.

- Technology and AI literacy: leverages analytics and emerging tools to support control objectives and propose solutions (with appropriate controls and governance).

- Familiarity with data visualization / reporting tools (e.g., Tableau). Alteryx and/or Python skills a plus.

- Familiarity with fiduciary regulatory requirements (e.g., ERISA, Conflicts of Interest, Part 9) is a plus.


Coordinate controls governance committees; synthesize risk metrics, track actions, and support control strategy & change initiatives

jobs.title: Vice President – Screening Efficiency & Analytics Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
Join us at Chase and make a real impact every day for your customers, your community, and yourself. Build your career on our strong foundation and help shape what’s next—for you and for us. We value creativity, growth, and collaboration, offering opportunities to advance your skills and career. Be part of a team that transforms data into decisions and solutions for a global leader in financial services.

As a Vice President - Screening Service Efficiency & Analytics Strategy Lead within JPMorgan Chase, you will lead the transformation of how sanctions screening performance is measured, analyzed, and improved—shifting the organization from reactive reporting to predictive, actionable insights that reduce false positives, improve performance, optimize end-to-end operational efficiency, and accelerate automation opportunities across the sanctions screening infrastructure and workflow. You will serve as a bridge between analytics/technology teams and operations, compliance, and governance forums, translating complex data into clear “brutal truth” narratives and decision-ready executive reporting.

Job Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain an enterprise metrics framework for sanctions screening, including KPI scorecards and leading/lagging indicators, with clear definitions, sources, and reporting cadence.

- Establish governance standards for metric definitions, data lineage, assumptions, and auditability; maintain documentation to support reviews/exams and change management controls. Lead recurring stakeholder forums to present insights, drive decisions, and track benefits realization from tuning, process changes, and automation.

- Analyze alert/case/disposition/investigation data to identify and quantify drivers of false positives (e.g., name commonality, geography, list updates, transliteration patterns, and data quality issues).

- Produce recurring trend and root-cause analyses on volumes, hit/true match rates, aging/throughput, and backlog drivers; segment performance by scenario/filter, list source, business/product, jurisdiction, and customer/entity attributes. Deliver data-driven tuning recommendations (e.g., threshold adjustments, token/alias handling, matching logic refinements, and data standardization), including pre/post measurement and regression monitoring.

- Define, monitor, and evolve filter/service KPIs (e.g., alert-to-customer ratio, override rates, repeat-alert rates, list refresh impact, etc)

- Perform structured performance reviews after watchlist updates, ruleset releases, parameter changes, and vendor upgrades; build monitoring to detect drift, sudden spikes, or unusual match patterns and trigger investigations/corrective actions.

- Map the end-to-end sanctions workflow and use data to identify bottlenecks, rework, duplicate effort, and queue imbalance; generate insights on cycle times, handoffs, productivity, and quality outcomes (e.g., reopen rates, QA outcomes, escalation patterns).

- Recommend process control improvements (e.g., triage logic, prioritization schemes, standardization of dispositions, workload routing) with clear success metrics and benefits tracking.

- Identify opportunities to automate low-risk, high-volume outcomes (e.g., repeat false positives, deterministic negative matches, smart routing, etc) and prioritize based on impact and control considerations.

- Build business cases for automation (expected alert reduction, capacity released, control impacts, residual risk) and partner with technology teams to implement analytics-enabled automation (rules-based and ML-assisted). Deliver advanced analytics capabilities (predictive modeling, segmentation, optimization, forecasting) and ensure outputs translate into operational/technology requirements with clear acceptance criteria.

- Design and partner with stakeholders to deploy automated dashboards and recurring reporting tailored to operational, risk/compliance, and executive audiences (e.g., queue health/throughput, QA trends and breach alerts, strategic KPIs and cost-per-alert). Translate complex datasets into clear, decision-ready narratives for senior leaders and governance forums, moving beyond spreadsheets to actionable insights and recommendations.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

- 5+ years in Data Analytics / Business Intelligence

- Banking operations domain expertise, with experience in client/transaction screening; AML, sanctions, or fraud analytics experience

- Demonstrated data stewardship & controls mindset: implementing data quality controls, lineage/traceability, and documentation supporting auditability and governance

- Proven communication and stakeholder management: ability to translate complex analytics into leadership-ready narratives and influence technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Experience with big data / modern data platforms (e.g., Hadoop, Snowflake, AWS data lakes) and Advanced SQL

- Proficiency in analytics tooling/languages: Alteryx, Python and/or R

- Data visualization & reporting: expert-level Tableau and/or Power BI (or similar) to deliver automated dashboards and management reporting

- Bachelor’s degree required (or equivalent practical experience)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

- Master’s degree preferred in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or an MBA with a heavy analytical focus


Come join our Business Analysis team to build your career in a culture that values innovation, creativity and excellence.

jobs.title: Vice President — Commercial Card & Prepaid Card Fraud Strategy Manager
jobs.description:

Join our team as a VP, Commercial Card & Prepaid Card Fraud Strategy Manager , where you will lead fraud risk management strategies that protect the firm while delivering an exceptional client experience.

As part of the Commercial & Investment Banking Payments Operations organization, you will lead a team responsible for fraud strategy across Commercial Card and Prepaid Card portfolios. You will identify emerging fraud trends, develop and optimize fraud detection strategies, and partner across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and external stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions that balance fraud prevention, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

This role is ideal for a strategic leader who combines strong analytical skills, business acumen, and stakeholder management expertise to drive measurable business outcomes in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Job Responsibilities:

-
Own fraud detection performance for assigned portfolios, balancing fraud losses, client experience, operational efficiency, and business objectives within established risk and performance thresholds.

- Lead and develop a team of fraud strategy analysts by setting priorities, managing capacity, coaching performance, and supporting career development.

- Identify emerging fraud trends through quantitative and qualitative analysis; develop, optimize, and monitor fraud detection strategies and rules to mitigate risk.

-
Evaluate strategy, rule, and control effectiveness, providing data-driven recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

- Partner across Product, Technology, Operations and Data Science to design, implement, and enhance fraud prevention capabilities and monitoring coverage.

-
Lead end-to-end strategy implementation, including business requirements, testing, release management, performance monitoring, and post-implementation validation.

-
Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, root-cause analysis, governance enhancements, and control standardization.

-
Represent the business in cross-functional forums with Card Operations, Claims, Collections, card networks, and external partners; provide executive-ready insights, recommendations, and updates to senior leadership.

-
Lead multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously, ensuring effective prioritization, execution, and delivery against business objectives and stakeholder expectations.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

-
8+ years of experience in fraud strategy, analytics, product management, risk management, or related functions supporting financial services, payments, or operations.

-
Proven leadership experience managing and developing analytical teams, including performance management, workforce planning, coaching, and talent development.

-
Strong business acumen and technical expertise with the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate operating models, and influence strategic decision-making through data-driven insights.

-
Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data sets, identify trends and opportunities, solve business problems, and translate findings into actionable recommendations and compelling executive-level narratives.

-
Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a structured approach to delivering complex initiatives under tight timelines across cross-functional teams; hands-on experience with Agile methodologies and JIRA for backlog management, reporting, and delivery tracking.

-
Experience with business process modeling, governance, and control frameworks, as well as data architecture concepts including ETL processes, relational databases, and large-scale data environments.

Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders across all levels of the organization.

-
Advanced analytical and technical skills, including hands-on experience with SQL and business intelligence/analytics platforms such as Tableau, Qlik, Alteryx, Python, R, or SAS.

-
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related discipline.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

-
Experience designing and optimizing fraud detection strategies, anomaly detection solutions, and fraud risk controls within commercial banking or payments environments.

-
Knowledge of Commercial Card, Prepaid Card, and broader payment ecosystems, including card processors, networks, fraud controls, and dispute/chargeback processes.

-
Experience working with card processors and fraud platforms such as TSYS, VCAS, Fiserv, MPTS, or similar solutions.

-
Experience managing relationships with card networks, including governance, performance management, and fraud risk initiatives.

-
Familiarity with machine learning concepts and partnering with data science teams on feature design, model development and performance management.

-
Outcome-oriented leader with a collaborative management style, strong ownership mindset, and demonstrated success operating within complex, matrixed organizations.

jobs.title: Wealth Management, Dynamic Multi-Asset Strategy (DMAS) Equity Portfolio Manager, Executive Director
jobs.description:
The Team

The Dynamic Multi-Asset Strategy (DMAS) team manages benchmark-agnostic, actively managed multi-asset portfolios designed to deliver attractive risk-adjusted returns while emphasizing capital preservation. The investment process combines top-down macro views, tactical asset allocation, and bottom-up security selection across equities, fixed income, commodities, liquid alternatives, and cash.

The team leverages proprietary research and resources across J.P. Morgan while maintaining an independent investment process and a high-conviction approach to portfolio construction. Portfolio managers actively allocate risk across sectors, geographies, styles, and investment themes, seeking opportunities with the most compelling risk/reward characteristics.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Equity Portfolio Manager to join the Dynamic Multi-Asset Strategy (DMAS) team. This individual will play a key role in the equity investment process, helping to identify high-conviction investment opportunities, formulate thematic views, and translate those insights into portfolio positions across DMAS strategies.

The successful candidate will be responsible for generating actionable investment ideas, conducting fundamental and thematic research, contributing to portfolio construction decisions, and helping manage equity risk across portfolios. The role requires close collaboration with portfolio managers responsible for fixed income, alternatives, and asset allocation decisions, as well as broad engagement with research resources across J.P. Morgan.

Job Responsibilities

Portfolio Management & Investment Strategy

- Primary responsibility for contributing to the management of equity allocations across DMAS portfolios, including funds, model portfolios, and separately managed accounts.

- Generate and implement high-conviction equity investment ideas through fundamental research, thematic analysis, quantitative inputs, and market intelligence.

- Participate directly in portfolio construction discussions, including security selection, position sizing, buy/sell decisions, and risk management.

- Contribute to tactical equity allocation decisions and broader portfolio positioning across varying market environments.

- Identify and implement opportunities across sectors, industries, geographies, market capitalizations, and investment styles.

- Monitor portfolio holdings and adjust positioning as market conditions and investment theses evolve.

- Evaluate portfolio risks and opportunities to ensure consistency with investment objectives and risk parameters.

Research & Security Selection

- Develop and maintain detailed investment views on companies, sectors, industries, and equity markets globally.

- Conduct in-depth fundamental analysis of individual securities and investment themes.

- Develop differentiated thematic investment views and identify emerging secular and cyclical trends capable of driving portfolio outperformance.

- Generate actionable investment recommendations supported by rigorous research and analysis.

- Leverage quantitative, fundamental, technical, and macroeconomic inputs to identify attractive investment opportunities.

- Articulate and maintain detailed investment theses and portfolio recommendations.

Portfolio Construction & Cross-Asset Collaboration

- Collaborate with portfolio managers across equities, fixed income, commodities, currencies, and liquid alternatives to maximize portfolio-level risk-adjusted returns.

- Evaluate portfolio exposures, factor risks, active bets, correlations, and diversification characteristics.

- Assist in constructing portfolios that balance alpha generation with disciplined risk management.

- Contribute to strategic and tactical asset allocation discussions across the broader DMAS platform.

- Implement investment views through individual securities, ETFs, mutual funds, and other investment vehicles, as appropriate.

Client Engagement & Thought Leadership

- Represent the team in client meetings, portfolio reviews, and investment discussions.

- Articulate investment views, portfolio positioning, and market outlooks to clients, advisors, and distribution partners.

- Contribute to investment commentary, market updates, thought leadership, and marketing materials.

- Support business development efforts by communicating the team's investment philosophy, process, and positioning.

- Partner with colleagues across investment, distribution, and client service teams to deliver a best-in-class client experience.

Process Improvement & Team Development

- Lead and participate in client due diligence through meetings and analysis to deepen understanding of business performance and management strategy
- Build and apply financial models to assess key value drivers and incorporate forward-looking scenarios into credit views
- Structure financing solutions using corporate finance and accounting expertise, aligned to the risk assessment
- Prepare, review, and present credit approval materials in line with credit risk policies and standards
- Review and negotiate legal documentation to ensure terms align with approvals and are appropriate for the risk profile
- Monitor the portfolio and maintain accurate risk ratings that reflect a current, forward-looking view of each client
- Identify emerging deterioration early and drive proactive risk management actions for problem situations
- Produce periodic portfolio summaries and annual review materials for senior management
- Support development of junior talent through coaching, training, and feedback
- Partner with analysts, middle office, and data teams to maintain accurate and timely credit system information

- Bachelor’s degree and 7+ years of commercial banking or investment banking lending experience, including credit analysis, deal structuring, and client coverage
- Strong understanding of financial products, corporate finance, financial modeling, and market dynamics
- Advanced knowledge of financial statements and accounting principles
- Experience preparing credit approval materials and applying credit risk policies and controls
- Experience reviewing and negotiating documentation related to credit agreements
- Knowledge of derivatives products and related documentation, including standard master agreements and collateral documentation
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to form sound, well-supported credit judgments
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in time-sensitive environments

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
- Master of Business Administration or Chartered Financial Analyst designation
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present to senior stakeholders
- Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes through clear recommendations and effective partnership
- Experience leading client diligence discussions and negotiating with external counterparties
- Demonstrated comfort operating in a demanding environment while managing multiple concurrent workstreams

jobs.title: 2028 Commercial & Investment Bank - Global Investment Banking Program - Full-time Analyst - Tokyo
jobs.description:
Working here means joining a collaborative, supportive team. We want your diverse perspective to help us innovate the next wave of products and solutions for our clients. We’ll give you what you need to succeed from training to mentoring from senior leaders to projects that engage all your skills.

As a Full-time Analyst in the 2028 Corporate & Investment Bank - Investment Banking Program, you will receive hands-on experience with extensive training. You will spend four weeks with our leaders and top consultants learning about our products, services and business practices through interactive learning tools, case studies and modeling sessions. We provide extensive pre-training coursework to build your financial and economic expertise.

Work alongside the top professionals in the business to come up with solutions that shape the global economy. Our bankers are focused on long-term relationships and developing strategies that help our government, institutional and corporate clients grow and innovate. We do this by providing sound advice, helping them access funds and making connections, all while helping clients manage the many risks in today’s complex environment.

Our industry and product teams work together to develop and execute strategies that help our clients grow and achieve their objectives in today’s global markets. Our industry and product teams include: Consumer & Retail, Corporate Finance Advisory, Diversified Industries, Energy, Equity Capital Markets, Financial Institutions, Financial Sponsors, Healthcare, Investment Grade Finance, Leveraged Finance, Media & Communications, Mergers & Acquisitions, Public Finance, Real Estate Gaming & Lodging, Regional Investment Banking, and Technology.

Job responsibilities

- Perform valuation analyses

- Work on mergers and acquisitions

- Build detailed financial models and execute transactions from pitch to close

- Analyze market data, building detailed financial models and prepare client presentations

- Develop innovative and creative ways to solve complex, real-world business challenges

- Learn how we help clients and communities grow, no matter their needs

- Sharpen your technical skills

- Build your professional network with mentors, senior executives and others

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Excellent analytical, quantitative and communication skills

- Excellent leadership and collaborative skills

- Knowing your way around Excel, PowerPoint and Word

- Japanese fluency is required for this role

- Pursuing a degree qualification with solid academic background and an expected graduation of April 2027 through March 2028

- Available to start full time employment from April 2028

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Business level of English is preferred

- Expertise in finance or economics a plus

Candidates requiring visa sponsorship may apply.

A portion of the interview process may be conducted in person in our Tokyo office.

Application Deadline

October 26, 2026 (23:59 Japan time)

HireVue Completion Deadline

October 28, 2026 (23:59 Japan time)

We will be filling our classes on a rolling basis. We strongly encourage you to submit your application as early as possible before job postings close.

Cover letter submission is not required as part of the application process.

What’s next?

Help us learn about you by submitting a complete and thoughtful application, which includes your resume. Your application and resume is a way for us to initially get to know you, so it’s important to complete all relevant application questions so we have as much information about you as possible.

After you confirm your application, we will review it to determine whether you meet certain required qualifications.

If you are advanced to the next step of the process, you’ll receive an email invitation to complete a video interview, powered by HireVue. This is your opportunity to further bring your resume to life and showcase your experience for our recruiting team and hiring managers.

HireVue is required, and your application will not be considered for further review until you have completed. We strongly encourage that you apply and complete these required elements as soon as possible, since programs will close as positions are filled.

JPMorgan Chase is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that respects all people for their unique skills, backgrounds and professional experiences. We strive to hire qualified, diverse candidates, and we will provide reasonable accommodations for known disabilities.

Please email us at  recruit.japan@jpmorgan.com  for any enquiries, and visit  jpmorganchase.com/careers  for upcoming events, career advice, our locations and more.

You will play a role in implementing the execution function including working with other A&D and coverage analysts and associates, as well as assisting more senior bankers. You will develop strong function skills in the major areas of M&A&D investment banking. Working with a broader team in the region, you will be provided opportunities to be involved in real-time transactions that may include travel.

Job Responsibilities:

- Perform technical analysis and resource / valuation assessment for oil & gas assets across North America

- Perform economic modelling including production forecasting, type curve creation, inventory assessment, LOS analysis, review of commercial assumptions, etc

- Be able to support senior engineers in the construction of and maintenance of economic modeling software such as ARIES or PHDwin

- Perform a variety of technical analyses on completion trends, rig activity, depletion risk, well decline analysis, etc

- Conduct market research from various platforms including Enverus, Woomdac, and Factset

Required capabilities, and skills

- Experience in technical evaluations of oil and gas assets across lower 48 conventional and unconventional play types

- Strong understanding of commonly used software programs such as Spotfire, ComboCurve, ArcGIS, QGIS and Microsoft Office Suite

- Experience with fundamental reservoir engineering analysis such as decline curve analysis, type curve creation and competitor analysis

- Support senior engineers & geologists in asset reviews (e.g. PDP forecasting, inventory assessment, type curves, LOS evaluations, geologic assessments)

- Working knowledge of sub-surface geologic characteristics and showcase the ability to perform geologic assessments alongside the A&D team’s geologists

- Assist with the development of marketing materials and execution of mandates

- Assist with the preparation of data room presentations and exhibit the ability to manage virtual data rooms

- Consistently be a team player and can work alongside motivated colleagues that express a willingness to be successful and are driven to win

Required qualifications

- 2-4 years of Petroleum Engineering experience conducting A&D evaluations

- Lower 48 un-conventional reservoir evaluation experience is preferred

- Petroleum Engineering undergraduate degree is required

- Deep level of economic understanding of development field economics :

- ARIES & Combo Curve experience required

- Spotfire experience required, working understanding of QGIS and ArcGis welcomed

Investment Banking (GIB)

Within Investment Banking, the firm works with a broad range of issuer clients, including corporations, institutions and governments, to provide comprehensive strategic advice, capital raising and risk management expertise. In-depth, industry-specific expertise and regional market acumen enable our industry coverage teams to serve the evolving needs of clients around the world. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients motivates everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term relationships by taking a holistic and forward-looking view on our relationships, and identifying ways to help clients achieve their most important business objectives.


JP Morgan is seeking an Engineer to join its Technical Transaction Team “TTT” within the Energy Investment Banking practice.

Seeking a dedicated Portfolio Manager to join our dynamic Fixed Income team.

jobs.description:

Coordinate end-to-end execution of AI POCs across the CMO organization and LOBs, ensuring prioritization, control gates, and delivery rigor.

-
Support a standardized intake and onboarding for new POCs (use-case definition, sponsor readiness, value hypothesis, resourcing, approvals).

-
Partner with Technology, Data/Analytics, Legal/Compliance, Privacy, Controls, and Risk to deliver controlled innovation and documented approvals.

Support and serve as a point of contact within Marketing for all Sandbox activities—intake, sponsorship alignment, execution tracking, and reporting.

Produce executive-ready updates (dashboards, decision memos, risk/issue escalations, portfolio readouts) that enable fast decisions and unblock deliver

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

-
8+ years in program management, transformation, marketing operations, technology enablement, and/or innovation execution with senior stakeholders.

-
Strong portfolio orchestration skills across multiple concurrent initiatives with clear prioritization and delivery discipline.

-
Exceptional stakeholder management and ability to influence across business, technology, data, and control partners.

-
Superior written/verbal communication; ability to translate complex AI topics into executive-ready actions and decisions.

-
Proven track record partnering with Technology, Data/Analytics, Legal/Compliance, Privacy, Controls, and Risk in a controlled innovation environment.

-
Strong external orientation and curiosity for emerging AI and martech trends.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

-
Advanced degree preferred.

-
Experience leading AI or technology-driven innovation at scale, preferably in Financial Services and/or Marketing.

-
Demonstrated ability to quantify and communicate business impact (growth, efficiency, cycle time, quality, risk reduction).

-
Familiarity with martech ecosystems and delivery environments (email ops, paid media/digital channels, content workflows, marketing measurement)


Support governed marketing artificial intelligence pilots, ensuring safe delivery, measurement, and executive reporting.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive - Mid-Corporate Banking - Executive Director
jobs.description:
You are customer focused, enjoy building relationships and bringing in new clients. A role as a Business Development Executive is for you.

As a Business Development Executive in Mid-Corporate Banking, you will be responsible for growing and retaining profitable relationships, while championing a culture of innovation and a customer centric mindset.

Reporting to the Region Manager you will be responsible for leading the business development efforts for Middle Market Banking in the region. Your primary role will be to help grow the business through client acquisition. You will be responsible for identifying and qualifying prospects and introducing our banking team, credit staff and other product partners as appropriate. This role is an opportunity to showcase your experience in business development, your ability to work independently, and your excellent partnership and marketing skills.

Job Responsibilities

-
Partner closely with Banking, Credit, Treasury and Service partners, as well as Asset Management and Investment Bank colleagues, to introduce our prospects to our product capabilities

-
Propel top line revenues while maximizing efficiency for the business, with a keen eye towards risk mitigation and compliance

-
Serve as mentor and coach to the banking team and lead the region’s prospecting activities. This may include cross-selling of existing clients when appropriate

-
Measure success by your effectiveness in many marketing areas, including but not limited to: calling activity, proposal generation, revenue generation, risk mitigation, ability to build successful relationships with centers of influence, and propensity to help build the franchise for the long term

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

-
10 years of direct client management, lending, credit support, or similar industry related experience

-
FINRA Series 63, 79 and Securities Industry Essentials licenses required or ability to obtain licenses within 180 days of hire

-
Extensive knowledge of Commercial Banking products and services

-
Experience in cross-selling products, and a track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals

-
Strong business development skills; including tactical selling and negotiation

-
Ability to partner well; i.e., develop and maintain positive and productive internal relationships with product partners, credit executives, senior management, client service, etc.

-
Excellent verbal and written communication skills - including proposal writing and public speaking

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

-
Bachelors degree preferred

-
Formal bank credit training is preferred

-
Strong creative solution and problem solving skills


Join the team providing financial solutions to Commercial Banking clients across the country.

jobs.title: 2027 Commercial & Investment Banking - Global Markets - Off-cycle Internship - Paris
jobs.description:
If you are ambitious and eager to apply your knowledge to real-world financial scenarios, this internship offers the opportunity to work with sophisticated financial solutions across asset classes in dynamic global markets.

Our Global Markets teams help clients manage risk, increase returns, and solve complex financial problems while tackling challenging business issues.

As an Off Cycle Intern in Global Markets, you will engage in a stimulating environment, exploring our sophisticated financial solutions across asset classes.

What You Can Expect

Our teams operate in all major financial markets and develop sophisticated financial solutions to help clients manage risk, increase returns and solve complex financial problems. Globally, we hold key positions across all major financial markets.

You’ll support senior colleagues with important research, analysis and preparatory work. You will monitor markets, develop trade ideas, conduct portfolio reviews, and learn about the solutions and products we offer for clients to manage any market conditions. Your work and contributions will be valuable to the team from the start. Expert instructors and J.P. Morgan professionals will teach you about our history, the scale and scope of our organization today and our ambitious plans for tomorrow. We’ll teach you technical and practical skills that will help you hit the ground running.

This is a pooled recruitment process whereby you will be considered for available roles that are to be recruited during your availability. Roles are recruited for quarterly with start dates in Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4.

Job responsibilities

- Develop sophisticated financial solutions to help clients manage risk, increase returns and solve complex financial problems.

- Solve a range of stimulating and interesting business issues.

- Support senior colleagues with key research, evaluation and preparatory work.

- Monitor markets and develop trade ideas.

- Conduct portfolio reviews.

- Learn about the solutions and products we offer for clients to manage any market conditions.

- Participate in hands-on experience, relevant skills training and valuable professional networking.

Job Summary

As a Global Markets Intern, you will join one of two tracks:

- Trading : a unique insight into global markets – we provide liquidity to clients in all major asset classes and pride ourselves on our fast execution, market share and e-trading platforms. A trader’s role is to respond to and encourage client enquiries, manage the resulting risk, and understand and respond to market-moving events. Trading is detail-focused, mentally stimulating and requires detailed evaluations.

- Structuring & Origination:   a dedicated team of professionals servicing the structured product requirements of our clients. The team offers a broad range of innovative investor products, liability management and hedging solutions. J.P. Morgan offers a wide range of derivatives products to institutional investors, distributors, corporates and private investors.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:

- Excellent analytical, quantitative (algebra, statistics, probability), and interpretative skills

- Ability to thrive in a dynamic, collaborative work environment

- Adaptable, flexible, and resilient

- Fluency in English

- Willing to take on some responsibility and manage your own projects in collaboration with your colleagues.

- Graduation date from July 2027 to January 2028.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills:

- Strong interest in global financial markets, as well as investigative and quantitative skills.

- Flexibility, attention to detail and thrives in a collaborative environment.

- Well-rounded academic background that includes details of extra-curricular positions is also of interest to us.

- We welcome applications from all degree disciplines and value the diversity of thought that different academic backgrounds bring. Given the nature of our Global Markets work, candidates who enjoy numerical, analytical and quantitative challenges are likely to thrive.

Beyond that, what we’re most interested in are the things that make you, you: the personal qualities, outside interests and achievements beyond academia that demonstrate the kind of person you are and the difference you could bring to the team.

We recommend that you apply to one Markets program only.

Additional Information
We fill our classes on a rolling basis and encourage early applications. At JPMorgan Chase, we champion innovative ideas and support your career growth in a diverse and inclusive environment. If you’re passionate, curious, and ready to make an impact, we’re looking for you.

What’s Next?

Help us learn about you by submitting a complete and thoughtful application, which includes your resume. Your application and resume is a way for us to initially get to know you, so it’s important to complete all relevant application questions so we have as much information about you as possible.

To start the application, you will be prompted to enter your email address. Your email address will be used to create and maintain your profile so make sure it is one you will have long term access to.  Do not use an email address with “.edu or .ac.uk” extension as doing so could result in delays receiving updates regarding your candidacy.

If you are advanced to the next step of the process, you’ll receive an email invitation to complete (1) a video interview and (2) a math test, powered by HireVue. This is your opportunity to further bring your resume to life and showcase your experience and skills for our recruiting team and hiring managers. Completion of the HireVue video interview and math test is required, and your application will not be considered for further review until you have completed both. We strongly encourage that you apply and complete these as soon as possible, since programs will close as positions are filled.


If you are enthusiastic, committed and looking to apply what you’ve learned to real-world financial experience, we have a role for you!

jobs.title: Program Manager- Product & Transformation
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for developing and executing strategic vision? Are you an expert collaborator that thrives on your ability to get the job done?  If so, join our dynamic team—this role is for you.

As a Program Manager in the Product & Transformation team, you will own the day-to-day activities related to project management, analysis, executive storytelling, and delivery of transformation initiatives for the Client Onboarding and Service (COS) organization. This highly visible role requires direct partnership with project stakeholders and senior leadership, including translating complex topics into clear PowerPoint narratives, operating effectively in the gray, and driving alignment across matrixed teams. You will be proactive, detail and results-oriented, and bring strong judgment, leadership presence, and communication skills to accelerate outcomes across the organization.

Job Responsibilities

- Own day-to-day analysis, project management, and delivery of COS strategic transformation initiatives across business, product, technology, and operations partners

- Convert strategic priorities into high-impact programs, including problem scoping, opportunity identification, solution design, delivery planning, and measurable business outcomes

- Develop executive-ready PowerPoint materials with clear storylines, meaningful content, and impactful visuals to communicate strategic vision, delivery milestones, risks, tradeoffs, and change management priorities

- Lead strategic discussions, pressure-test ideas, and bring creativity in both thought and paper; this is not an execution-only role

- Engage product and technology development teams for all domains using agile methodology for client journeys and persona planning

- Drive change, consensus and alignment on the target state vision and roadmap, including preparing impact assessments, change management plans and communications

- Operate effectively in 'in the grey’ or evolving environments by bringing structure, sound judgment, and practical recommendations to issues without clear precedent

- Apply understanding of innovation in financial services and emerging technologies (e.g. machine learning, Blockchain, robotics process automation) to reimagine the future of the Commercial and Investment Bank

- Develop strong trusted advisor relationships with key client stakeholders

Required Qualifications, capabilities and skills

- Educated with a Bachelor of Science or Arts degree and seasoned, typically demonstrated by 7+ years of relatable business experience (transformation, program management, strategy, consulting, or operations)

- Comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic, matrixed environment, with the ability to operate “in the grey”

- Able to clearly communicate and influence, leading leaders to a common goal

- Outstanding in relationship management, interpersonal skills, and communication, with the tenacity to resolve issues and conflicts

- Advanced in PowerPoint, with demonstrated ability to create executive-ready materials, build compelling storylines, simplify complex topics, and translate analysis into persuasive narratives

- Proficient in data analysis, including interpreting information, identifying insights, and using facts to support program execution and leadership decision-making

- Successful with a track record of setting and achieving challenging goals, demonstrating entrepreneurial leadership

- Proven in leading and managing complex programs or projects, delivering results across multiple business units, functions, or stakeholder groups

- Effective at interacting with colleagues at all levels and achieving goals without direct control over resources

Preferred Qualifications, capabilities and skills

- MBA-qualified with a relevant advanced degree

- PMP-certified (or holding other project management certifications)

- Passionate about learning new operating models, technologies, and industry trends

- Experienced in integrating artificial intelligence or automation solutions to enhance project outcomes, improve decision-making, or streamline workflows

- Seasoned with previous client consulting experience

Joining our diverse and innovative global organization will provide you with endless opportunities for career and personal growth.

- Become a part of our many Business Resource Groups, employees who come together on topics such as ethnicity, gender, age, accessibility, special interests and more

- Help the community through expansive volunteer opportunities

- Join one of our focus groups aimed at Innovation and Transformation, creating the future experience for our clients and employees

Final Job Grade and officer title will be determined at time of offer and may differ from this posting.

Some travel required (20%) to visit clients and internal partners.

Please note this role is not eligible for employer immigration sponsorship.


Transform Onboarding by turning strategic priorities into executable programs, executive narratives, and measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Risk Decisions - UAT & Quality Transformation VP
jobs.description:
Join JPMorganChase Risk Management and Compliance at the center of strengthening a firm that serves millions of customers and communities. Lead quality outcomes for decisioning platforms that power critical moments across the Risk lifecycle—from Offer Generation and Acquisitions through Account Management. You’ll modernize testing with automation and GenAI-enabled practices while operating in a well-controlled, audit-ready environment. jobs.title: Control Management - Vice President, Program Manager – Innovation & AI Transformation
jobs.description:

You’ll partner across lines of defense and business teams to improve effectiveness, consistency, transparency, and capacity while balancing risk, privacy, and control requirements.
