jobs.title: Payments Governance Manager
jobs.description:
Step into a high-impact leadership role at the center of payments governance and third-party oversight. You will shape scalable governance strategies, strengthen risk identification and issue evaluation, and translate industry, regulatory, and payment network requirements into decisive action. This role offers the opportunity to lead a talented team, deliver transformation programs, and influence senior stakeholders across a complex payments ecosystem.
As a payments governance operations manager in payments governance operations, you will lead the modernization of a complex oversight function supporting third-party payment processing and related relationships. You will set strategy, drive scalable governance and monitoring, and partner across functions to strengthen controls, issue management, and decision-making.
Job responsibilities
- Set the strategic direction for payments governance, balancing disciplined risk management with responsible business growth across products, regions, and regulatory environments
- Lead and develop a multi-level team through clear priorities, coaching, performance management, and succession planning
- Provide subject matter expertise on payments risk, payment network rules, and applicable regulatory and policy requirements impacting third-party payment processing
- Direct the evaluation of issues, risk events, and control gaps by assessing materiality and root cause, defining mitigation plans, and driving timely escalation and closure
- Own the governance framework for onboarding due diligence, assessments, periodic monitoring, evidence standards, quality assurance, documentation retention, and remediation tracking
- Deliver a modernization roadmap to replace manual processes with scalable workflows, automation, analytics, and technology-enabled monitoring
- Lead transformation programs end-to-end, including business case development, scope and resource planning, change adoption, and executive reporting
- Use risk indicators, control results, and portfolio trends to identify vulnerabilities, prioritize interventions, and measure governance outcomes
- Partner with product, technology, risk, fraud, credit, compliance, legal, sales, finance, and operations stakeholders to embed governance requirements across the client and product lifecycle
- Advise senior stakeholders on risk posture, trade-offs, escalations, remediation plans, and readiness decisions with clear, structured communication
- Promote a culture of ownership, integrity, continuous improvement, and constructive challenge to strengthen governance and controls

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills
- Leadership experience in payments, merchant acquiring, financial services, third-party risk, governance, operations, or another highly regulated environment
- Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation, including governance, milestones, dependencies, and change management
- Demonstrated ability to evaluate risk and control effectiveness, identify emerging risk themes, and drive appropriate escalation and remediation
- Experience using data, key risk indicators, and trend analysis to generate actionable insights and influence decisions
- Ability to partner effectively with technology teams to translate business and control requirements into implementable solutions
- Demonstrated ability to communicate complex topics clearly to senior stakeholders, including through written materials and presentations
- Demonstrated judgment and decision-making under pressure, including managing sensitive escalations and driving accountable resolution
- Demonstrated people leadership, including coaching, talent development, and fostering an inclusive team culture
- Willingness and ability to travel as needed ( TBD travel frequency/expectations)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills
- Experience with payment facilitator, marketplace, staged digital wallet operator, business payment service provider, full liability submitter, or comparable third-party payment models
- Knowledge of major payment brand program rules and acquirer obligations (for example, Visa and Mastercard)
- Experience modernizing governance, risk, or operations through workflow technology, automation, artificial intelligence, analytics, or digital reporting
- Experience designing or enhancing risk-based monitoring, issue management, control testing, due diligence, quality assurance, or remediation frameworks
- Working knowledge of analytics and project delivery tools (for example, Alteryx, Tableau, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms)
- Experience supporting regulatory examinations, audits, payment brand reviews, or senior governance forums
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, risk management, technology, operations, or a related discipline


Lead payments governance modernization and third-party oversight to strengthen risk identification, controls, and scalable operations.

jobs.title: Compliance Risk Management Lead - Vice President
jobs.description:
Bring your expertise to JPMorganChase. As a Vice President in Compliance, Conduct and Operational Risk Management (CCOR), you will play a critical role in supporting the firm’s strength and resilience. You provide oversight for responsible business growth by identifying and assessing new and emerging risks, applying sound judgment, and delivering innovative, risk-based solutions that support our company, clients, and communities. Our culture values strategic thinking, continuous improvement, and collaboration.

As a Compliance Risk Management Lead - Vice President supporting the Compliance, Conduct and Operational Risk (CCOR) organization, you will report to the team's Executive Director focusing on the Kinexys by J.P. Morgan business unit, which sits in the Commercial & Investment Bank (CIB) Payments business.  In this role, you will provide second line oversight, assess compliance and operational risk for new Kinexys products, technologies, and vendor relationships, and support process improvements across the business.

You will be part of a diverse team of CCOR professionals, fostering cross-functional collaboration and supporting all areas of the business globally. Your contributions will help ensure innovative, risk-based solutions and robust controls for business partners.

Kinexys is a pioneer in banking-led blockchain, transforming traditional business models and the movement of money, information, and assets.  CIB Payments is among the world’s largest, most trusted and innovative full-service providers in one of the most dynamic and rapidly transforming spaces in financial services. In addition to providing international cash management, liquidity, commercial card cross currency, escrow solutions, merchant services and trade finance, we continue to invest in future-growth initiatives, such as blockchain, AI & ML, as well as form partnerships with rising fintechs to expand our client base and product offerings. Operating in over 160 countries and handling more than 120 currencies, CIB Payments offers specialized solutions that provide operating efficiencies and value beyond other standardized solutions available in the market. Our global product and technology platform, integrated client service model and network of operational centers enable CIB Payments to deliver a consistent set of services to clients no matter where they are across the world.

Job Responsibilities

- Support compliance and operational risk management activities across Kinexys and CIB Payments, aligning with firmwide objectives and regulatory expectations.

- Collaborate with business and functional stakeholders in the review and implementation of new products, services, vendor relationships, and client onboarding, ensuring robust risk and control frameworks.

- Participate in working groups to develop and enhance blockchain / digital ledger technology risk management frameworks.

- Represent Payments CCOR in control forums, business meetings, and industry events, communicating clear and compelling risk and compliance messages.

- Monitor regulatory and legislative changes, providing oversight and guidance for business implementation of new rules and regulatory requirements.

- Support second line controls to ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and firm policies, contributing to continuous improvement and process efficiency.

- Review and assess new business initiatives for regulatory and operational risk implications, supporting innovative and compliant business outcomes.

- Foster cross-functional collaboration with Compliance, Operational Risk, Legal, Product, Payments, Audit, Finance, and Control Management teams, promoting knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

- Participate in team development and feedback, contributing to an inclusive environment for growth and excellence.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

- Significant experience in compliance, operational risk, audit, or internal controls within a complex, global environment.

- Understanding of blockchain business use cases and distributed ledger technology, digital assets, and associated risks, with experience managing emerging risks and regulatory challenges.

- Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements and deliver risk-based solutions aligned with business objectives.

- Strong interpersonal, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, establishing credibility with business partners and external stakeholders.

- Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and projects simultaneously.

- Proven execution and project management skills, ensuring timely resolution and delivery of high-quality results.

- Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to operate effectively across teams and geographies.

- Self-motivated, results-driven, and committed to achieving higher standards and continuous improvement.

- Ability to foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment, supporting professional development and knowledge sharing.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

- Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry best practices in blockchain, digital assets, and payments.

- Experience with payments or financial services preferred.

- Experience in supporting change, driving innovation, and managing disruption in financial services.

jobs.description:
Job Description — Senior Associate, Business Analytics (Chief Data Office, CIB)

Role Summary

The Chief Data Office (CDO) within the JPMorganChase Commercial & Investment Bank (CIB) is seeking a Senior Associate to support high-priority CIB initiatives focused on increasing quality of Sales’ data for the Markets business. This role is project-driven (little fixed BAU), requires strong analytical problem-solving, and will partner closely with business, product, and technology stakeholders to identify data quality issues, size impact, and drive resolution paths from discovery through remediation.

Key Responsibilities

- Deliver analytics for high-priority CIB programs , per the Sales CDO’s strategy, with a focus on improving the quality and usability of data used by Markets Sales.

- Perform data quality assessments (profiling, anomaly detection, reconciliation, completeness/accuracy/timeliness checks) and quantify business impact.

- Lead issue triage and resolution planning : document findings, identify root causes, propose remediation options, and define/track resolution paths with owners.

- Build and maintain repeatable workflows for data preparation and analysis.

- Develop dashboards and reporting to monitor data quality metrics, remediation progress, and key outcomes for senior stakeholders.

- Partner cross-functionally with CIB stakeholders (product teams, data owners, tech teams, control/operational partners as applicable) to align on definitions, requirements, and prioritization.

- Improve documentation and controls : data dictionaries, business rules, issue logs, and operational runbooks for project deliverables.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

- Strong experience in business analytics / data analytics roles (typically 5+ years, or equivalent depth).

- Hands-on capability with:

- Alteryx (automating analytics workflows, data blending, validation)

- Dashboarding (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar—building stakeholder-ready views and KPIs)

- SQL / Python (data extraction, cleaning, analysis, automation; ability to productionize analytics where appropriate)

- AI-enabled improvement experience   demonstrated ability to apply AI/ML and generative AI techniques to reduce manual effort, accelerate data analysis, and improve decision making

- Demonstrated ability to work in ambiguous, project-based environments with shifting priorities and tight timelines.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including writing clear issue narratives and presenting insights to non-technical audiences.

- Proven experience identifying data quality issues and driving structured remediation with accountable owners.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

- Experience with data quality tooling (e.g., Informatica, Collibra  or similar DQ/profiling platforms).

- Familiarity with data governance concepts (critical data elements, lineage, controls, metadata, stewardship).

- Experience working with Client/Sales/CRM-type datasets (contacts, coverage, relationship hierarchies, Core Reference data) and associated quality challenges.

- Comfort working across large enterprise data ecosystems and collaborating with data and engineering teams.

Competencies

- Analytical rigor and curiosity; strong hypothesis-driven problem solving

- Strong attention to detail; comfort with imperfect data

- Ability to translate business problems into data tests and measurable metrics

- Self-starter, able to work autonomously, with strong time management skills; efficient at multi-tasking and able to work under pressure to deliver multiple business demands on-time, to a high standard

- Excellent communication, presentation (both oral and written) & influencing skills - candidate will be dealing with stakeholders of varying degrees of seniority

jobs.title: Compliance - Technology Operational Risk Management (Technology Development) – Vice President
jobs.description:
Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities.

As Vice President Technology Development Risk Lead in Technology and Cybersecurity Operational Risk Management, you form an independent view of whether the controls over software delivery still hold now that a large share of code is written by artificial intelligence agents. You will use data-first approaches to show what is actually happening across the engineering estate, challenge the first line on what that data reveals, and report a position that senior management and regulators can rely on. You will do this as an individual contributor, close enough to the technology to stay credible with the engineers you challenge.

Your role offers the opportunity to join the Tech and Cyber Operational Risk Management team, responsible for the successful implementation and execution of the Compliance, Conduct, and Operational Risk framework within JPMorgan. You will provide Second Line of Defense challenge and oversight to our technology and cybersecurity partners. We are looking for someone who has built software and can hold their own with the engineers they challenge, and who will raise the analytical bar of the people around them without managing them.

Job Responsibilities:

-
Perform independent risk assessments of the controls governing how software is planned, written, reviewed, tested, and released, using data-first approaches and advanced analytics.

-
Challenge the first line on the control model applied to artificial intelligence coding assistants and agentic development tooling, covering human review of generated code, attribution of authorship, and the audit trail behind every change.

-
Evaluate the entitlements and credentials granted to development tooling and autonomous agents, and whether access controls still hold when a machine rather than a person initiates a change.

-
Assess whether observability and telemetry across the engineering estate is sufficient to detect data loss, misuse, and unexpected agent behaviour.

-
Utilize Python and SQL to analyze large engineering data sets, and build dashboards and reports that make development risk visible to senior management.

-
Define and test statistical hypotheses to identify thematic risks in software delivery from key risk indicator and key performance indicator performance.

-
Develop and maintain the annual oversight plan for this domain, and report an independent view to senior management, control committees, internal audit, and regulators.

-
Assess the prioritization and treatment of control findings, and monitor first line remediation to closure.

-
Coach and develop junior data scientists and risk professionals, raising the analytical bar of the function.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

-
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

-
5-10 years of experience in technology risk, technology audit, software engineering, or application security within financial services.

-
Hands-on software development experience in Python.

-
Experience querying and analyzing data in SQL.

-
Hands-on experience with the software delivery toolchain, including source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, and automated testing.

-
Experience assessing or testing technology controls such as change management, access management, or secure software development.

jobs.title: Subsidiary Payments Sales Manager - Senior Associate
jobs.description:
Join our North American Subsidiary Payments Sales team and help shape how clients use payments solutions to run and grow their businesses. In this role, you’ll drive new opportunities while supporting day-to-day relationship management for a portfolio of inbound Large Corporate Asia Pacific Headquartered corporate clients. You’ll collaborate with partners across the organization to deliver a strong client experience and measurable results. We invest in training and development so you can continue to grow your career with us.

As a Payments Sales Manager Associate in the Payments Corporate Sales team, you will develop new business and support day-to-day relationship management for a portfolio of corporate clients within the Subsidiary Payments Sales vertical. You will build and execute a disciplined selling strategy in partnership with product and subsidiary banking/coverage teams to deliver client outcomes and grow the pipeline. You will collaborate with cross-functional partners to optimize delivery and support ongoing client engagement. You will develop a strong understanding of client operating structures, buying processes, and objectives to position Payments solutions effectively.

Job Responsibilities

- Deepen and grow existing client relationships through proactive engagement and disciplined follow-up

- Support portfolio growth by assisting senior sales managers with sales execution and client engagement activities

- Develop new profitable business from prospective clients by identifying needs and proposing solutions

- Document deal solutions and proposals and prepare materials for client presentations and negotiations

- Manage proposal development and the end-to-end sales process, including competitive requests for information and proposals

- Partner with product stakeholders by representing the client perspective in the development and evolution of products and solutions

- Understand client goals, operating environments, strategies, and trends to identify requirements and uncover new business opportunities across the full product suite—traditional cash management, trade & working capital, liquidity, foreign exchange, commercial card, and merchant acquiring.

- Monitor and update the Sales pipeline, ensuring accurate and timely data entry

- Support the development and maintenance of account plans and documentation for account reviews and strategy sessions

- Operate with a risk-based mindset with strict adherence to compliance, controls, and quality standards

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

-
3+ years of experience in cash management, sales, and relationship management

-
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field

-
Knowledge and understanding of Payments products

-
Ability to assess opportunities and engage key decision makers

-
Strong creative solutioning and problem-solving skills

-
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including negotiation skills

-
Ability to develop collaborative relationships with key internal partners –Sales, Product Management, Client Service, Global Corporate Bank, Investment Banking and Implementations

-
Strong attention to detail and time management skills

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

- Self-motivated and able to work independently as well as part of a team


Drive new business and manage client relationships by delivering payments solutions that improve client outcomes.

jobs.title: Quant Analytics Manager - Credit Card Marketing - Vice President
jobs.description:
Help shape how data and insights drive decisions across our Credit Card business. You’ll tackle high-impact problems end-to-end—translating business questions into analytical approaches and communicating insights that influence strategy and outcomes. You’ll join a collaborative team where your work can directly improve customer and business experiences through responsible, scalable analytics.

As an Analytics Manager in our Credit Card marketing analytics team, you’ll generate targeted marketing lists that support co-brand partner campaigns and help ensure the right customers receive the right offers. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and partner stakeholders to align targeting to campaign goals, while maintaining strong data quality and compliance standards. You’ll also bring a multi-channel analytics mindset to uncover insights and optimize campaign performance.

You’ll use SAS, Snowflake, and Python to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources, and you’ll help build repeatable, automated workflows that enable scalable execution. You’ll be a trusted partner who can connect analytics work to business decisions, and you’ll support the team by coaching and mentoring analysts.
Job responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and optimize marketing lists for co-brand credit card campaigns, ensuring accuracy and alignment to partner requirements

- Collaborate with marketing stakeholders to understand campaign objectives, target segments, and business goals

- Apply credit card marketing knowledge (acquisition, retention, cross-sell) to inform list generation and segmentation strategies

- Use SAS, Snowflake, and Python to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources

- Design and implement automated workflows for list generation and campaign tracking

- Validate data quality and apply controls to support privacy and regulatory compliance in marketing activities

- Deliver insights and recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness and customer targeting

- Document processes and maintain clear communication with internal and external partners

- Coach and mentor analysts on the team

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Analytics, Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or related field

- Experience in credit card marketing or financial services with demonstrated understanding of marketing activities and processes

- Advanced proficiency in SAS for data manipulation and analysis

- Advanced proficiency in Snowflake for data extraction and analysis

- Advanced proficiency in Python for data manipulation and analysis

- Experience working with data governance, privacy, and regulatory requirements in marketing

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

- Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional environment

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Experience supporting credit card partnerships or partner-led marketing campaigns

- Familiarity with campaign management tools and customer relationship management platforms

- Knowledge of customer segmentation and marketing analytics techniques

- Experience with predictive modeling to support targeting and optimization

- Experience applying multi-channel marketing analytics to improve campaign performance


Drive co-brand credit card marketing analytics by building compliant targeting lists and actionable insights.

jobs.title: Payments Sales Manager - Broker Dealers & Market Structure - Executive Director
jobs.description:
Join the NA Broker Dealers and Market Structure Payments Sales team!

As a Payments Sales Manager (PSM) Executive Director within the Financial Institutions Group, you will drive new and existing business across the North America Broker Dealers and Market Structure segments. You will own a portfolio of traditional and neo broker dealers, clearinghouses, and exchanges, building trusted senior-level relationships and delivering end-to-end client coverage and service. In this role, you will develop and execute disciplined account plans, build and advance a strong pipeline of opportunities, and achieve new business sales goals by aligning client needs to sophisticated payments solutions. You will also partner with clients on JPMorganChase’s innovative capabilities, including the Kinexys blockchain technology platform, to deliver differentiated outcomes and deepen strategic relationships.

Job Responsibilities

- Drive sales for the entire Payments product suite, including treasury services which covers core cash management, liquidity management and FX solutions

- Execute JPM Payments sales & client strategy to achieve new business sales objectives, maintain current revenue streams, expand market share and increase the share of wallet with clients.

- Work closely with domestic and overseas coverage and product partners to identify opportunities to provide sophisticated treasury/payments solutions to clients; Collaborate with client service, compliance, operations, technology, risk, credit, legal in order to optimize delivery.

- Stay current on all aspects of the client relationship, including revenue levels, balance levels, credit exposure, KYC compliance.

- Conduct comprehensive client analysis to identify strategic opportunities to market JPMorgan's payments products and solutions to address client specific needs.

- Negotiate and finalize documentation for pricing updates, RFPs, client events and other ad-hoc proposals.

- Execute a comprehensive selling strategy in conjunction with Product and the Banking coverage officers; Sell Payments products with value to the firm as well as build a strong pipeline of new deals.

- Gain a thorough understanding of the market, the industry in which the client operates, the client's organizational and operating structure, buying process and business objectives to effectively position JPM and solutions optimally.

- Engage clients at senior and strategic levels to provide integrated treasury solutions within a consultative and client-focused framework. Create strategic dialogues around key client-centric issues, incorporating best practices, benchmarking, opportunity quantification, and solution positioning.

- Manage the entire sales process, including supervising end-to-end implementation and day-to-day operations of client solutions.

-
Work as a team and provide leadership to organize and co-ordinate client events as to promote and strengthen J.P. Morgan’s franchise.

Required qualifications, skills and capabilities:

- 10+ years experience selling cash and liquidity management products with in-depth knowledge of such products.

- Proactive with strong initiative and good team player with ability to take ownership and achieve sales goals.

- Strong knowledge in cash, foreign exchange, liquidity and information management products.

- Familiarity with innovative cutting edge treasury/payments products, in addition to an understanding of the credit/risk process and the compliance nuances of digital assets.

- Demonstrated ability to work across internal teams and external clients globally.

- Demonstrated ability to identify supplemental sales opportunities, position and close new business, and assist in the design, sale and delivery of value-added services.

- Competence in assessing new opportunities/prospecting, contacting key decision makers.

- Strong account planning and demonstrated execution.

- Comprehension of customer's industries (broker dealers, market makers, exchanges/clearinghouse), business needs and potential solutions.

- Excellent verbal communication and negotiation skills.

- Understanding of the regulatory and compliance environment in the market with strong experience in AML/KYC risk and control process.


As a key member of the team, you will drive the end-to-end client experience

jobs.title: Payments - Subsidiary Payments Sales Manager BeNelux - Vice President /Executive Director (Amsterdam)
jobs.description:
Join the EMEA Subsidiary Payments Sales team. As a key individual contributor on the team, you will drive the end-to-end client experience for an inbound Payments portfolio of Large Corporate North American HQ clients.
As a  Subsidiary Payments Sales Manager (PSM) within the Subsidiary Payments Corporate Sales team, you will be responsible for developing new business from clients within the Subsidiary Payments Sales vertical. You will be expected to structure relevant EMEA Payments solutions for clients with value as well as build a strong pipeline of opportunities.
In order to achieve your sales goal, each PSM is expected to execute a comprehensive selling strategy in conjunction with Global Corporate Banking, Subsidiary Banking, and Product. You will also be required to collaborate with stakeholders across the business - client service, implementation, operations, technology, risk, credit, legal in order to optimize delivery. You will also be responsible for actively gaining a thorough understanding of the market, the industry in which the client operates, the client’s organizational and operating structure, buying process, regional nuances and business objectives to effectively position J.P. Morgan and Payments solutions optimally.
Job responsibilities
- Deepen and grow existing market relationships
- Work in partnership with bankers to develop new profitable business from prospective clients
- Engage J.P. Morgan Payments Solutions, bankers and clients at senior and strategic levels to provide integrated treasury solutions within a consultative and client driven framework
- Partner with internal product stakeholders when representing the client perspective in the development/evolution of complex products and solutions
- Understand clients’ business goals, environments, strategies, and industry trends to better determine their requirements and identify potential new business opportunities for J.P. Morgan Payments via appropriate solution(s); traditional cash management, trade & working capital, liquidity, TSFX, commercial card and merchant acquiring.
- Understand the competitions’ capabilities and gaps, and how to position J.P. Morgan Payments
- Manage client visitation and contact; promoting sales through frequent client meetings and discussions covering new products, market and industry developments
- Manage proposal writing and the entire sales process including both competitive RFIs/RFPs
- Develop and enhance in-depth client knowledge and share it with the client coverage team for both new business development and management of client risk
- Address business issues such as risk, legal, and compliance, and manage resolution, including conducting AML due diligence reviews of high-risk industry clients.
- Work closely with the subsidiary banking coverage team to drive efforts to expand existing business with current clients, providing feedback to product managers and generating cross-sell opportunities by maintaining strong working relationships with other J.P. Morgan lines of business

Required qualifications, skills and capabilities
- Strong experience in a financial services sales focused role, providing payments and cash management services (6+ years industry experience)
- Demonstrated ability to develop and deepen senior client relationships
- Deep knowledge of payments ecosystem covering transaction banking, merchant acquiring and working capital
- Ability to develop creative solutions to optimize working capital levels across the organization
- Ability to develop collaborative relationships with key internal partners –Sales, Product Management, Client Service, Global Corporate Bank, Investment Banking and Implementations
- Must have strong leadership, presentation and communication skills
- Proven ability to negotiate and execute large scale projects
- Clear and effective communication written & verbal communication skills – English required,

Preferred qualifications, skills and capabilities
- Dutch or an Asian language preferred


Come and join the EMEA Subsidiary Payments Sales team in Amsterdam

jobs.title: Business Development Executive - Innovation Economy Technology Banking - Executive Director
jobs.description:
You are customer focused, passionate about working with and supporting technology companies in the Innovation Economy, enjoy building relationships and bringing in new clients.  A role as a Business Development Executive is for you.

As a Business Development Executive on the Technology Banking team, you will play a pivotal role in expanding our presence within the innovation economy and have a history of business development experience and a strong network in the technology/startup ecosystem.

The Technology Banking team is part of J.P. Morgan's Commercial Bank in its Commercial and Specialized Industries group. In this role, you will be a creative and strategic thinker to build community and brand awareness in the local   market including driving the prospecting strategy, client acquisition, channel partner management, and strong collaboration with the local Bankers in your market.  We work both independently and as part of a dynamic team to deliver the entire firm to our clients.

Job Responsibilities

- Drive top line revenues while maximizing efficiency for the business, with a keen eye towards risk mitigation and compliance

- Lead the new business origination strategy for the local market in close coordination with local market executives and the venture capital coverage team.

- Identify top technology companies in the Innovation Economy and connect with their key executives (Founders, CFO, VP of Finance, etc.).

- Utilize data-driven insights to prioritize prospects and tailor customized outreach strategies.

- Build a channel partnership pipeline with success and market share tracking, working with the Startup Banking team to build a standardized approach for measurement and evaluation.

- Leverage COI relationships to enhance outreach efforts and drive new client acquisition.

- Execute a strategic events strategy focused on building new connections and enhancing the JPMorgan brank in your market

- Keep a pulse on market trends and emerging technologies, with a focus on ecosystem and network growth in the territory assigned

- Partner closely with Banking, Credit, Treasury and Service partners, as well as Asset Management, Private Bank and Investment Bank colleagues, to introduce our prospects to our broad product capabilities.

- Serve as mentor and coach to the banking team and lead the region’s prospecting activities. This may include cross-selling of existing clients when appropriate.

- Plan and host networking and content-focused events with key centers of influence in the local market.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

- 10+ years of business development, commercial banking, or other relevant sales experience in the technology ecosystem.

- Proven track record of sourcing and navigating complex sales opportunities, ideally in commercial banking, venture debt, venture capital, or other technology-related services.

- Ability to build community and brand awareness in a dynamic market.

- History of planning and executing an events and content strategy.

- Utilize seasoned judgment to offer comprehensive and customized solutions that best meet potential client needs.

- Monitor and research market/industry trends and business outcomes to present relevant and insightful solutions to potential clients.

- FINRA Series 79, 63 and Securities Industry Essentials licenses required or must obtain within 180 days of hire

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

- Ability to leverage your network, market knowledge, and startup experience to deliver a top-notch client and partner experience

- A deep understanding of JPMorgan Commercial Banking products and services

- Ability to work collaboratively with our Bankers, Treasury Management Officers, and other key product partners

- Capable of operating independently and possesses excellent partnership, communication, and marketing skills


Join the team providing financial solutions to Commercial Banking clients across the country.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive-Healthcare Services-Executive Director
jobs.description:
You are customer focused, enjoy building relationships and bringing in new clients. A role as a Business Development Executive is for you.

As a Business Development Executive on the Healthcare Services, Emerging Middle Market Banking team, you will be responsible for acquiring  profitable relationships, while championing a culture of innovation and a customer centric mindset.

The Healthcare Services team is part of J.P. Morgan's Commercial Banking and Specialized Industries group.  Reporting to the Industry Executive, you will be responsible for leading the business development efforts for Emerging Middle Market Healthcare Services in the East region. Your primary role will be to help grow the business through client acquisition. You will be responsible for identifying and qualifying prospects through direct outreach, development of relationships with centers of influence and external industry events and introducing our banking team, credit staff and other product partners as appropriate. This role is an opportunity to showcase your experience in business development, your ability to work independently, and your excellent partnership and marketing skills.

In this role you will be the focal point of client acquisition and ongoing relationships with the world’s most innovative companies. We work both independently and as part of a dynamic team to deliver the entire firm to our clients.

Job Responsibilities

- Partner closely with Banking, Credit, Treasury and Service partners, as well as Asset Management and Investment Bank colleagues, to introduce our prospects to our product capabilities

- Propel top line revenues while maximizing efficiency for the business, with a keen eye towards risk mitigation and compliance

- Serve as mentor and coach to the banking team and lead prospecting activities. This may include cross-selling of existing clients when appropriate

- Measure success by your effectiveness in many marketing areas, including but not limited to: calling activity, proposal generation, revenue generation, risk mitigation, ability to build successful relationships with centers of influence, and propensity to help build the franchise for the long term

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

- 10 years of direct client management, lending, credit support, or similar industry related experience

- Extensive knowledge of Commercial Banking products and services

- Experience in cross-selling products, and a track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals

- Strong business development skills; including tactical selling and negotiation

- Ability to partner well, i.e., develop and maintain positive and productive internal relationships with product partners, credit executives, senior management, client service, etc.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills - including proposal writing and public speaking

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

- Bachelors degree preferred

- Formal bank credit training is preferred

- Strong creative solution and problem solving skills


Join the team that provides comprehensive banking and financial solutions to Commercial Banking clients.

jobs.title: Senior Product Associate - Marketing & Customer Success
jobs.description:
At JPMorganChase, we build products that matter — and the people behind them matter just as much. This is your opportunity to grow your career at the intersection of product strategy, partner engagement, and digital innovation.

As a Senior Associate of Product Marketing and Customer Success at JPMorganChase within the Digital Channels team, you will support day-to-day partnership with lines of business, helping align digital capabilities to business goals and contributing to adoption and value realization efforts. You will assist in defining value propositions, supporting intake and prioritization processes, coordinating enablement resources, and tracking post-launch performance. This role is ideal for a collaborative, detail-oriented professional who is eager to grow their product marketing and partner management skills in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

Job responsibilities

- Support ongoing understanding of line of business priorities, success metrics, and performance gaps to help identify opportunities for digital capability alignment

- Assist in serving as a point of contact for line of business stakeholders, helping represent their needs within Digital Channels and contributing to key communications

- Contribute to go-to-market alignment for digital initiatives by helping translate strategy into partner-facing materials and incorporating line of business feedback

- Help track and report on goals and key results (OKRs), providing regular visibility into progress and outcomes for stakeholders

- Support strategic planning efforts by gathering competitive insights, coordinating analytics partnerships, and contributing to innovation forums

- Assist in managing stakeholder communications on behalf of Digital Channels, helping build trust and consistently articulating the Digital Channels value story

- Help maintain a prioritized line of business backlog by documenting current and future work and supporting roadmap integration across teams

- Participate in intake and requirements processes with Performance Marketing by documenting use cases, clarifying requirements, and ensuring submissions are complete and accurate

- Develop and maintain enablement materials such as playbooks and coordinate product demos to support capability rollout and partner readiness

- Monitor post-launch adoption and performance metrics, contributing to reporting on business impact in partnership with program management as needed

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Formal training or certification on product management concepts and 3+ years applied experience

- Demonstrated ability to support execution within the product development lifecycle, including familiarity with agile methodologies and cross-functional workstreams

- Strong organizational and project management skills with experience managing multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder needs simultaneously

- Experience contributing to operational effectiveness initiatives with a focus on reducing friction and improving measurable outcomes

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information into clear summaries, action plans, and stakeholder-ready materials

- Ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and build productive working relationships with diverse stakeholders

- Analytical mindset with experience supporting key performance indicator tracking, performance reporting, and data-informed storytelling

- Experience contributing to enablement resources such as playbooks, training materials, or product demos that support adoption and partner readiness

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Exposure to digital marketing, performance marketing, or channel strategy within a financial services or technology organization

- Familiarity with product intake and prioritization frameworks, including backlog documentation and demand tracking

- Experience working with data and analytics teams to surface insights that inform stakeholder reporting and strategic recommendations

- Background in customer success, partner support, or go-to-market coordination with an ability to connect product capabilities to business value

- Interest in competitive intelligence and innovation practices that inform product positioning and roadmap contributions


Support digital adoption and partner success by connecting product capabilities to real business outcomes across lines of business.

jobs.title: Models Marketing Manager - J.P. Morgan Asset Management
jobs.description:
Build the marketing engine behind a fast-growing solutions business at J.P. Morgan Asset Management and shape how advisers discover, evaluate, and adopt model portfolios, translating investment insights into clear, compelling narratives that drive engagement and measurable growth. You’ll work at the intersection of product, investment, sales, and digital to bring campaigns to life in the moments that matter.

As a Senior Models Marketing Manager in J.P. Morgan Asset Management, you will lead end-to-end marketing for our model portfolio offering, from positioning and messaging to go-to-market planning and advisor-facing content. You will develop integrated campaigns that help advisers understand what the models are, how they are used in practice, and why they fit specific client objectives. You will partner closely with distribution marketing strategy and the investment and product teams to translate portfolio construction, process, and updates into marketing that is accurate, differentiated, and easy to act on. You will track results, iterate quickly, and continually raise the bar for how we show up across advisor platforms and channels.

Job responsibilities

- Own US models marketing strategy and annual plan to drive awareness, consideration, and adoption

- Define positioning and messaging for flagship lineups and key use cases

- Lead go-to-market for launches, enhancements, and major portfolio updates, in close partnership with distribution marketing strategy, product, investment, legal, and sales

- Translate investment process, portfolio construction, and rebalancing into clear advisor narratives and tools

- Produce core content (playbooks, one-pagers, pitch materials, FAQs) that improves advisor usability

- Optimize digital journeys across web, email, and platforms through testing and iteration

- Enable sales with toolkits, training, field feedback loops, and implementation guidance

- Build education, thought leadership, and practitioner content using firmwide resources and centers of excellence

- Track competitive landscape and advisor needs to sharpen differentiation and remove adoption friction

- Report performance with robust measurement, dashboards, and data discipline; share insights and actions with stakeholders

- Present at QBRs and participate in weekly sales meetings to align priorities and accelerate execution

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- 8+ years of experience in asset management, wealth, product, or solutions marketing

- Demonstrate success marketing multi-asset solutions or model portfolios to financial advisers and intermediaries

- Translate complex investment topics into clear, compliant, advisor- and client-friendly messaging

- Lead integrated go-to-market execution with distribution marketing strategy and cross functional stakeholders across product, investment, sales, digital, legal, and risk partners

- Create content that supports an advisor’s day-to-day workflow, including practical implementation tools

- Apply data and analytics to manage campaigns, measure funnel performance, and optimize outcomes

- Communicate with executive presence through strong writing, editing, and narrative development

- Manage multiple priorities with disciplined program management, stakeholder alignment, and attention to detail

- Uphold high standards for accuracy, process rigor, and collaboration in a regulated environment

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Bring experience with advisor platforms and model distribution ecosystems

- Show a track record of launching new investment solutions or scaling an established lineup through campaigns and enablement

- Use competitive positioning tools, including message testing and differentiation frameworks

- Apply working knowledge of portfolio construction, risk profiles, and rebalancing practices for model portfolios

- Partner effectively with sales leadership and field teams to drive measurable adoption

- Improve digital journeys (site content, email programs, lead nurturing) through testing and analytics

- Manage agencies and vendors across creative, content, and research workstreams


Lead the model portfolio marketing strategy, content and launches to help advisors deliver better client outcomes.

jobs.title: Consumer Content Marketing Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
As Vice President, Consumer Content Marketing, you will craft brand moments and stories Germany wants to talk about. You will shape culture-led consumer communications and translate central guidance into Germany ‑ specific narratives, then orchestrate a content calendar that lands consistently across web, social, events and partner channels. You will coordinate paid content in partner channels with the Media team to amplify the reach of the ideas you create. You will be responsible for managing content holistically to create external facing materials for your programs, working closely with Campaigns and Chase PR.

Job Responsibilities

-
Define the Germany content marketing strategy from central guidance and turn it into clear, culture ‑ first stories and content plans.

-
Own the content calendar across channels; coordinate with Campaigns and channel owners so messages are orchestrated and aligned.

-
Analyze consumer research and market trends in Germany to deepen audience understanding, align with German culture and industry developments, and tailor story angles and headlines.

-
Work with copywriters and designers to develop messaging frameworks and content.

-
Lead external-facing content and speaking program end-to-end: own core materials and program recurring formats from concept to delivery (e.g., podcasts).

-
Brief and manage agencies and partners; review and sign off plans and assets; ensure timely delivery and brand consistency.

-
Coordinate paid content in partner channels such as advertorials with the Media team to amplify earned moments.

-
Drive effective project management so programs, content and assets are delivered on time and to quality.

- In partnership with Chase PR, oversee agency partners to amplify campaigns and stories in the consumer press.

-
Develop and deliver content ‑ led earned programs, materials (web/social/events/webinars), and media collaborations.

-
Monitor coverage, sentiment and impact; track content metrics; run post ‑ program reviews and share recommendations for continuous improvement.

-
Collaborate with Chase PR, Legal and Compliance on approvals and reputational alignment.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

-
Significant experience in consumer communications, public relations or content marketing for well ‑ known brands with nationwide reach in Germany.

- University degree with a marketing focus (or equivalent experience).

-
Proven ability to build culture ‑ first stories and integrate content across owned, social and partner channels.

-
Strong storytelling and messaging skills; comfortable developing frameworks and working with copywriters and designers.

-
Experience managing agencies and coordinating cross ‑ functional stakeholders to deliver integrated programs.

-
Strategic thinking with strong execution; attention to detail; organized and reliable in fast ‑ paced, deadline ‑ driven environments.

-
Excellent organizational, communication and collaboration skills; confident presenting to senior stakeholders.

-
Fluency in German and English, written and verbal.

-
Commitment to maintaining firm standards related to risk, compliance and the Code of Conduct.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

- Solid understanding of the financial services or adjacent regulated industries.

- Experience overseeing recurring content formats (e.g., podcast, YouTube, webinar series).

- Experience in multinational organizations with central brand guidelines and local execution.

- A mix of agency and in ‑ house experience for a consumer business.


As Vice President, Consumer Content Marketing, you will craft brand moments and stories Germany wants to talk about. You will shape culture-led consumer communications and translate central guidance into Germany‑specific narratives, then orchestrate a content calendar that lands consistently across web, social, events and partner channels. You will coordinate paid content in partner channels with the Media team to amplify the reach of the ideas you create. You will be responsible for managing content holistically to create external facing materials for your programs, working closely with Campaigns and Chase PR.

jobs.title: Risk Management - Strategic Risk Analytics Associate
jobs.description:
Bring your expertise to JPMorganChase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you will be at the center of keeping JPMorganChase strong and resilient. You will help the firm grow responsibly by anticipating new and emerging risks and applying your expert judgment to solve real-world challenges that affect our company, customers, and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is centered on thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best in class.

As an Associate on the Credit Risk Management team, you will support Chase Card Services by delivering analytics and insights that inform credit risk decisions related to co-brand portfolio conversions and new product features. You will partner with teams across Risk, Product, Marketing, and Technology to balance portfolio performance with business objectives while strengthening decision rules and monitoring capabilities. You will help identify risks and opportunities, translate analyses into clear recommendations, and promote strong risk management practices.

Job responsibilities:

- Monitor internal and external behavioral data and industry trends to continuously improve risk management processes

- Identify and assess performance trends using statistical, data mining, and quantitative methods

- Analyze and challenge the performance of key business initiatives, independently generating solutions and recommended actions

- Conduct root cause analysis and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leaders and stakeholders

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate – Investor Relations (IR)
jobs.description:

- Working knowledge (or strong interest in developing knowledge) of hedge fund and private equity fund structures, products, asset classes, and operational workflows.

jobs.description:
Bring your Expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

As an Trade Credit Risk Associate in Trade Credit Risk, Wholesale Credit Risk , you provide independent credit judgment and constructive challenge on receivables/inventory/supply chain financing transactions . You partner with product, sales, coverage, legal, and risk stakeholders to deliver well-structured solutions that align risk views with deal execution. You support transaction reviews, documentation assessment, and ongoing portfolio monitoring, while helping strengthen policies, controls, and risk management practices as the platform grows. Covered product suite also includes medium-long term export & agency finance, trade loans and letters of credit / guarantees.

- Review new originations, renewals, and amendments for structured working capital transactions, including structure, obligor and counterparty risk, collateral, and repayment sources

- Analyze key documentation terms and identify risk mitigants to support well-governed approvals

- Advise first-line partners on credit line requests by assessing product suitability, structure, and controls

- Communicate risk views and propose solutions for transactions in the pipeline

- Monitor transaction-level and portfolio-level performance, including emerging risks and concentrations

- Develop risk monitoring frameworks as the portfolio expands and adds product variations

- Apply portfolio analytics and data-driven insights to enhance monitoring, trend detection, and decision support

- Evaluate variations from standard documentation and product guidelines and recommend risk management decisions

- Partner with stakeholders to assess new product structures, policy exceptions, and control solutions

- Support the rollout of new trade products by contributing to risk policies and controls

- Deliver training on trade products and associated risks to internal partners

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Minimum 3 years of experience in credit risk, trade risk, or structured finance

- Strong credit analysis skills, including transaction structuring and risk identification

- Relevant experience or strong interest in structured working capital finance or other trade finance products, or transferable experience from adjacent fields such as securitisation and asset financing.

- Ability to work effectively in a time-sensitive environment while managing multiple priorities

- Strong business and analytical judgment with a solutions-oriented approach

- Ability to analyze portfolio data, identify trends, and translate insights into clear risk views

- Comfort using technology-enabled tools (including large language model tools where appropriate) to support monitoring and reporting

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to tailor messaging to different audiences

- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence decision-making through constructive challenge

- Demonstrated ownership mindset and collaborative approach across partners with differing priorities

- Experience interpreting and negotiating legal documentation

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Experience with supply chain finance, export and agency finance, trade loans, or letters of credit

- Experience supporting new product development, policy design, or control implementation in a risk setting

- Experience reviewing policy exceptions and documenting approvals and controls

- Experience providing training or coaching on product risk topics

- Exposure to portfolios spanning the United States, Canada, and Latin America

jobs.title: Energy Strategy, Procurement & Sustainable Operations, Executive Director
jobs.description:
Step into leadership role shaping the future of sustainability across our corporate operations, including global real estate, procurement, and amenities portfolio, and serve as a resource on energy strategy, procurement and sustainable properties to leaders across JPMorganChase..

As an Energy Strategy, Procurement & Sustainable Operations Executive Director, on the Global Real Estate team, you will lead enterprise-scale energy procurement and operational sustainability initiatives, partnering closely with senior leaders to integrate environmental performance into day-to-day operations and long-term strategy. This role combines technical expertise, financial acumen, program leadership, and cross-functional coordination to deliver measurable environmental and asset value outcomes at scale.

Job Responsibilities

- Drive enterprise-wide decarbonization strategies, delivering financially viable, measurable efficiency and emissions reduction outcomes across our operations.

- Assess financial implications, risks, and strategic trade-offs of energy and sustainability investments and develop data driven recommendations to deliver to senior leadership

- Partner with senior leaders and cross functional teams to embed sustainability principles into operations, and long-term real estate strategy

- Oversee programs and initiatives designed to minimize the firm’s operational impact

- Guide the development and execution of sustainability initiatives that enhance asset value, resilience, and performance

- Establish consistent, enterprise-wide approaches, standards, governance, and controls for sustainable practices, including auditable data and disclosures

- Lead cross functional collaboration to advance sustainability priorities across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups, orchestrating delivery through a global operating model

- Lead and develop a team of ~15 energy and sustainability professionals

-
Support internal and external communications related to sustainability strategy, progress, and outcomes

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

- 10+ years of leadership experience in energy and sustainability

- Expertise in data/control frameworks, with the ability to lead complex, matrixed organizations and influence senior stakeholders

- Ability to evaluate the financial implications, risks, and strategic trade-offs of complex transactions, and make clear recommendations on preferred alternatives.

- Demonstrated experience with enterprise project execution at global scale

- Proven ability to lead enterprise-level programs balancing short-term delivery with long-term strategic objectives

- Strong qualitative and quantitative analytical skills

- Ability to manage, analyze, and communicate insights from large and complex data sets

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including senior-level presentations

- Ability to build credibility, influence stakeholders, and lead effectively in a cross-functional setting

- Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment

- High level of professionalism, self-motivation, and sense of urgency, with experience leading and developing high-performing teams.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

- Master’s degree or MBA

- Demonstrated experience managing large-scale sustainability and renewable energy programs within a real estate portfolio or Fortune 500 organization

- Sustainability leadership experience delivering decarbonization programs across operational and financed emissions

- Expertise in energy and sustainability governance, GHG accounting


Lead enterprise energy procurement and operational sustainability, driving decarbonization, governance, and a global team

jobs.title: Asset Management - Commercial Real Estate Acquisitions (West Coast Region) - Vice President
jobs.description:
Role Summary

As a Vice President on the West Region Investment Team, the successful candidate will source, negotiate, diligence, and close equity investments in office, industrial, multifamily, and retail properties in the San Francisco Bay Area.  The Vice President will be responsible for the sourcing, underwriting, investment committee presentation, due diligence, structuring, and closing of new acquisitions and development opportunities across all points on the risk spectrum.   The Vice President will be responsible for managing deal teams, including analysts and associates in acquisitions, as well as coordinating with asset management, engineering, research and other JPM and external teams.

Job Responsibilities

-
Generate investment opportunities at all points on the risk spectrum, through marketed and off-market channels.

-
D evelop and manage partner, broker, and other industry relationships to generate deal flow and market/product expertise.

-
E stablish bidding and negotiation strategy and adjust the same to respond to feedback during negotiations.

-
Efficiently evaluate, underwrite, and recommend appropriate investment opportunities.

-
Clearly identify and communicate risk and reward in each investment opportunity and price such risk appropriately.

-
Build internal consensus on valuation and transaction structure through proactive communication with all constituencies (including the CIO, portfolio management, asset management, research, valuation, financial, debt capital markets, and development/engineering).

-
Res ponsible for developing the investment strategy and business plan, writing investment committee memoranda, and presenting and advocating transactions at investment committee.

-
Lead due diligence teams and coordinate seamlessly with portfolio management, asset management, development/engineering, debt capital markets, valuation, financial, and other teams (including outside counsel and third-party consultants) to identify and resolve diligence issues.

-
Lead on transaction negotiation and documentation.

-
N egotiate with a focus on identifying and mitigating risk.

-
Exhibit leadership in partnering with internal teams and in developing junior team members.

-
P roactively seek ways to expand Global Real Assets' impact across the firm.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

- 5+ years of real estate acquisitions experience

- Experience in some or all of the office, industrial, multifamily, and/or retail sectors

- Experience mentoring and training junior associates and analysts

- Exceptional relationship building and negotiation skills including sales brokers, operating partners, owners, and other third parties

- Excellent quantitative modeling and analytical skills, including familiarity with ARGUS

-
Strong written and communication skills

-
Ability to think strategically and work independently

-
Attention to detail

- Experience in the San Francisco Bay Area

This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorganChase’s review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.

jobs.title: Technology Support Lead - Problem Management & Governance Lead
jobs.description:
Join our dynamic Production Management team to strengthen technology resilience, improve service quality, and drive effective governance across the core services that support our business.

As a Problem Management Lead in Employee Platforms, you will serve as a subject matter expert for end-to-end problem management, with a primary focus on identifying root causes, reducing recurring incidents, improving service stability, and ensuring that remediation and closure decisions meet established risk, control, resiliency, and documentation standards.

Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to influence technology teams and business stakeholders through clear communication, effective challenge, and data-driven recommendations.

Job responsibilities

-
Serve as the subject matter expert for end-to-end problem management across application and infrastructure services, from problem identification and classification through root cause analysis, remediation, validation, and closure.

-
Leads team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to improve incident triage speed and consistency (e.g., synthesizing operational signals into prioritized actions), with human-in-the-loop validation and appropriate handling of sensitive data.

-
Execute policies and procedures that ensure operational stability and availability and lead incident, problem, and change management in support of full stack technology systems, applications, or infrastructure.

-
Analyze incident trends, recurring issues, service-impacting events, and operational data to identify systemic problems and prioritize remediation based on business impact, risk, and customer experience.

-
Facilitate structured root cause analyses and post-incident reviews, ensuring contributing factors, control gaps, and lessons learned are documented and translated into sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

-
Establish clear ownership, milestones, and success measures for problem records and remediation actions; monitor progress, escalate delays, and provide transparent reporting to technology and business stakeholders.

-
Partner with engineering, operations, service owners, and control functions to deliver sustainable remediation, improve service resilience, and reduce the recurrence and business impact of known issues.

-
Maintain problem records and known-error information, ensuring workarounds, technical findings, risk acceptances, and remediation plans remain current, accessible, and aligned with established standards.

-
Identify operational risks and control deficiencies through problem management activities and coordinate appropriate mitigation, governance, audit, and compliance actions.

-
Define and report problem management metrics, including recurrence, aging, remediation effectiveness, root cause categories, and reductions in incident volume or business impact.

-
Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted practices across incident/problem/change routines to identify recurring interruption patterns and validate remediation actions aligned to resiliency and security expectations.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

-
5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise troubleshooting, resolving, and maintaining information technology services.

-
Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support production operations workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.

-
Ability to review and validate AI-assisted incident recommendations before action, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to operational, security, and auditability expectations.

-
Experience managing applications or infrastructure in a large-scale technology environment both on premises and public cloud.

-
Proficient in observability and monitoring tools and techniques.

-
Experience executing on processes in scope of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework.

-
Demonstrated experience managing end-to-end problem records, root cause analyses, corrective actions, known errors, and recurrence-prevention activities.

-
Strong analytical skills with experience using incident trends and operational data to identify systemic problems and prioritize remediation based on impact and risk.

-
Ability to manage operational risk, control requirements, resiliency expectations, and auditability needs within a complex technology environment.

-
Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to challenge constructively and communicate effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

-
Experience supporting Problem Management, Production Management, Site Reliability Engineering, or Operational Excellence activities within a large enterprise environment.

-
Knowledge of structured root cause analysis methods, post-incident review practices, known-error management, and corrective and preventive action management.

-
Experience defining and reporting problem management metrics, including recurrence, aging, remediation effectiveness, root cause categories, and service impact reduction.

-
Familiarity with enterprise-authorized AI, automation, analytics, or AIOps capabilities used to support operational analysis and workflow efficiency.

-
Relevant industry certification or formal training in ITIL, Service Management, Site Reliability Engineering, cloud technology, or operational risk management.


Lead technology teams in enhancing operational stability and performance in a top-tier financial firm.

jobs.title: Vice President, Client Success Team Lead - Chase Media Solutions
jobs.description:
Chase Media Solutions harnesses the power of Chase to help brands connect more meaningfully with 80 million Chase customers. Our transaction-based marketing platform leverages first-party data to expertly match businesses with audiences, inspiring valuable relationships that last through the Chase Offers program. As part of Offers & Shopping and Connected Commerce, we drive incremental growth for merchants while helping Chase customers level up how they shop and get more from the brands they love.

As a Vice President, Client Success Team Lead within Chase Media Solutions, you will report to the Head of Client Success and lead a team focused on maximizing revenue growth and retention through an engaging, consultative client experience for brands and agencies by delivering value through our Chase Offers platform. If you have experience building and leading high performance account management teams, excellent organization and communication skills, and are passionate about growing a new emerging media channel we would love to hear from you.

Job responsibilities

- Build out the Client Success function for Chase Media Solutions

- Lead a team of client success managers and associates to deliver excellent service to clients

- Collaborate with the sales organization to craft client success strategies to win new business and retain and grow existing clients to achieve revenue targets

- Partner cross-functionally with key support teams such as sales, operations and analytics to create a cohesive client engagement experience, ensure successful executions and drive continuous improvement to deliver for our clients

- Implement client feedback strategy to identify key success factors and pain points within our product offering and our client experience to help inform sales/marketing strategy, process improvements and product enhancements to better deliver for clients

- Implement approach to resolving client issues and escalations

- Develop and maintain a strong understanding of key vertical market trends and customer opportunities

- Represent Chase Media Solutions at events and serve as a brand and business ambassador

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- 5+ years of account management experience within the digital media or performance marketing industry

- 2+ years of account management leadership experience

- Demonstrated leadership ability in building, inspiring and managing high-performing, scalable client success teams

- Deep understanding of the digital media landscape and the role of account management to deliver successful client solutions

- Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and exceptional interpersonal communication skills to build internal and external client relationships

- Ability to perform and navigate ambiguity in a highly dynamic, rapidly changing, and growing environment

- Experience presenting to executives and marketing leadership both internally and externally, with strong interpersonal skills and a high attention to detail

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Vertical expertise in key consumer categories such as grocery, dining, gas & convenience, retail, travel

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US. We are not able to provide immigration sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Final job grade level and corporate title will be determined at time of offer and may differ from this posting.


Join Chase Media Solutions to create value for leading brands and agencies through a new emerging media channel.

jobs.title: Vice President, HR Business Advisor - Compliance, Conduct and Operational Risk (CCOR)
jobs.description:

CCOR’s independent, trusted experts partner across the firm to identify and manage compliance, conduct and operational risks, strengthen controls, and promote the highest standards of integrity and accountability.

As a Vice President (VP), HR Business Advisor (HRBA) supporting select teams within CCOR, you will be a trusted advisor to senior leaders, translating business and risk priorities into an actionable people agenda. You will use data, business acumen, and sound judgment to influence workforce strategy, organizational design, talent and succession planning, performance, and compensation decisions across a complex, global organization. You will lead execution in partnership with HR colleagues and business stakeholders, helping leaders strengthen organizational capability and deliver sustainable business and talent outcomes.

- Lead cross-LOB initiatives  and large-scale change efforts, serving as the HRBA point person accountable for delivery, stakeholder management, and results.

- 6+ years of progressive HR experience, including direct advisory work with senior leaders.

- Demonstrated ability to  i nfluence senior leaders and operate effectively in a large, global, matrixed organization.

jobs.title: Firmwide Compensation Vice President
jobs.description:

- Analyze compensation, headcount, financial, performance, market, and workforce data to support and advise on strategic compensation decisions, differentiation, and competitive pay practices

- Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and adherence to risk, control, regulatory, and policy requirements when working with sensitive workforce and compensation data
